jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Lead the Engineering Organization That’s Building the Future of HVACR Tool Technology

Fieldpiece
is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We’ve built our reputation by developing innovative tools and instruments that HVACR professionals rely on every day to do their jobs easier, faster, and better. As we continue to grow, expand our connected product portfolio, and invest in AI and platform-based engineering, we're evolving our engineering organization to support the next stage of our growth.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering
who enjoys building as much as leading. You'll help shape how engineering works. We're entering an exciting phase of growth that requires evolving our engineering organization. You'll build scalable processes, technical governance, engineering metrics, and development practices that support increasingly sophisticated products while preserving the speed, creativity, and entrepreneurial culture that have made Fieldpiece successful. You’ll help decide when to build capability, when to build process, and when to leverage external expertise - all while ensuring Fieldpiece retains ownership of the product architecture, customer experience, and technologies that differentiate us in the market.

This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028.
Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years , we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.

What You'll Do

Build scalable engineering processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable the organization to grow while maintaining speed, quality, and innovation.
Establish a scalable platform architecture that promotes reuse across hardware, firmware, software, and connected technologies while improving product quality, accelerating development, and supporting long-term maintainability.
Help evolve the organization from entrepreneurial product development to a more scalable engineering operation while preserving the agility and customer focus that define Fieldpiece.
Establish consistent product development practices, technical reviews, design standards, metrics, and decision-making frameworks across engineering disciplines.

What Success Looks Like

Become a trusted leader within the engineering organization while building strong cross-functional partnerships across Product Management, Operations, Quality, and external engineering partners that enable the organization to operate as one integrated product development team.
Establish an engineering operating model that balances technical excellence, scalable processes, and organizational agility - knowing when to build internal capabilities, when to standardize processes, and when to leverage external expertise to accelerate innovation.
Strengthen engineering execution by implementing scalable development processes, technical governance, meaningful performance metrics, and resource planning that ensure the right mix of internal talent and external partners to deliver best-in-class products.
Develop and execute a roadmap for the engineering capabilities, technologies, and organizational investments needed to support Fieldpiece's continued growth in connected products, AI-enabled solutions, and platform-based engineering.

Qualifications

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or another STEM discipline
12+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within FLC R&D / new product development environments.
Demonstrated success building, developing, and mentoring high-performing matrixed engineering teams through process improvement, performance management, and organizational planning.
Strong strategic leadership skills with the ability to balance long-term organizational development with short-term business priorities.
Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, especially when navigating complex technical and organizational challenges.
Experience partnering with ODMs, global suppliers, or international engineering organizations.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, resource planning, and investment prioritization.
Experience implementing Lean product development or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Bonus Points If You Have

Master's degree or MBA is a plus.
Experience leading engineering organizations that develop connected products, embedded systems, or IoT technologies.

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece

As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short-term results.
Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real world problems.
Make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business.

Benefits & Perks

We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
Generous paid time off and paid holidays
Hire to Retire philosophy - Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices)
Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes

Our Culture

At Fieldpiece, Our Values Shape How We Work, Collaborate, And Serve Our Customers Every Day. We Use The TURTL Acronym To Show That We Believe In

TRIBE – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team.
Upfront Homework – We come prepared, begin with the end in mind and address obstacles with creativity, grit and tenacity.
Right Stuff – We deliver innovative solutions by seeing through the eyes of our customers and use purposeful critical thinking to lead to greatness.
Trust – We build strong relationships through credibility, accountability and transparency.
Lean – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, learning from failures and delivering results.
No Ego – We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect.

At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products - we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Lead Director, Software Development Engineering
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

Our Analytics Engineering
team within the Data & Analytics division of our Data, Digital, Analytics, Technology (DDAT) organization is seeking a Lead Director, Software Development Engineering
. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals who are ready to lead a team of analytics engineers (software, ML, data) who support Aetna’s data science teams. Our work ensures that we apply the tools and resources at our disposal to deliver a best-in-class experience for our members, providers and plan sponsors.

This leadership role has a broad technical portfolio of data, analytics, software and machine learning assets that ensure our teams are able to build and deploy intelligence at scale across batch and real-time use cases. As the healthcare landscape evolves and changes, our team’s work is a crucial part of the overall CVS Health mission: transforming care to drive superior health outcomes and a seamless patient and consumer experience.

As a Lead Director, you will be responsible for guiding teams as they build best-in-class applications that integrate advanced analytics capabilities (predictive models, LLMs, vector search) into applications and data products built within the Google Cloud Platform. You will develop the strategies and tactics that we use on the path to delivering cutting-edge products, leveraging your expertise in engineering management, software architecture, and agile development lifecycles. As you join a high-caliber group of engineering leaders dedicated to delivering impact quickly while ensuring our technical assets and architecture are constantly maturing, your experience, instincts, and insights will enable us to iterate quickly while we explore bold technical solutions to complex problems. You encourage the team and champion the delivery of the right software at the right time, ensuring that we maximize our impact.

Responsibilities

Technical oversight: Technical leader capable of designing and overseeing the build-out and operations of complex distributed systems at scale in a fast-paced analytics organization
Engineering leadership: Able to technically direct, support, and evaluate data, software, and ML engineers and their work product, ensuring we are building best-in-class solutions that can scale to meet our future non-functional requirements
System performance: Monitor and optimize both team & system performance, identifying opportunities for enhancement and addressing any issues or bottlenecks. Establish KPIs and OKRs that unlock quantitative insight so we can change processes with confidence.
Talent management: Recruit, manage, mentor, and retain a high-performing engineering team while contributing to a positive and supportive culture, encouraging innovation, and driving a pragmatic balance of continuous improvement and effective value delivery.
End-to-end ownership: Lead teams from strategy through delivery in complex and highly visible engineering projects.
Prioritization and pivots: Guides team’s work prioritization in alignment with our strategic objectives. Coach implementation teams through pivoting as needed while remaining steadfastly focused on the overall objective.
Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate closely with other technical teams (engineering, platform, infrastructure, security, governance) to understand their expectations and develop solutions in accordance with appropriate guidelines.
Coalition building: Establish effective relationships with partners and customers, ensuring that you understand their vision and can help them deliver on their goals.
Risk management: Proactively identify, communicate, and mitigate both internal and external risks. Communicate clearly on progress, challenges, and opportunities to senior management and stakeholders, including presenting technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
The big picture: Understand how data, data science, and AI/ML can drive clinical and healthcare delivery strategies. Build partnerships that enable business innovation through data and analytics.
Staying current: Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development, analytics, data engineering, and machine learning technologies to drive innovation and efficiency.

Required Qualifications

10+ years as a hands-on software development engineer
5+ years designing & building high-volume distributed software systems
5+ years recruiting, managing, and retaining a high-performing team of software development professionals in an agile environment
2+ years developing containerized software applications in public cloud
2+ years exposure to analytics, data engineering and machine learning lifecycle, tools, and best practices
2+ years designing, building, and operating real-time streaming systems and associated system-building blocks (messaging, caching, etc.)
1+ year managing engineering managers
1+ year using generative AI as an integrated component in software solutions
1+ year in the healthcare or health insurance industry with deep understanding of health care value chain

Preferred Qualifications

Strong experience in web services, microservice and service-oriented architectures
Expert in Python, Java, Go, .NET or other similar programming languages
Expert in SQL, relationship database management systems, and non-relational or no-SQL database management systems.
Ability to diagram complex software architectures and communicate complex engineering ideas to non-technical stakeholders both visually and verbally
Expert in relationship management for both technical and non-technical customers and stakeholders
Strong understanding of cloud-based technologies (GCP, Azure, AWS), engineering frameworks and tools
Experience delivering in Agile, SAFE, Kanban, and Lean practices.
Experience in data strategy, data architecture, cloud software engineering design patterns, data science & machine learning methodologies, systems integrations, analytics/BI program management (SQL, Python, R, Java)
Understanding and familiarity with CI/CD, cloud devops, containers (kubernetes/Docker, etc.), Python/PySpark, dataproc, dataflow, pub/sub, and other GCP managed services

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a software discipline, or equivalent work experience.

Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.description:
Description

Role Summary

The Director, AI & Automation leads the team responsible for building and scaling the organization's automation and agentic AI capabilities. This role owns a team of engineers working across two closely related domains: workflow orchestration and deterministic automation, and agentic coding practices and AI-enabled engineering.

This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role at the leading edge of how the organization applies AI to internal operations. The Director is expected to be a practitioner and a leader - someone who understands the technology deeply enough to make good engineering decisions, develop strong engineers, and contribute meaningfully to how the organization thinks about AI adoption and governance over time.

Essential Functions

Lead a team of engineers across agentic AI and workflow automation disciplines, organized into self-directed pods aligned to business domains; ensure pods are staffed, enabled, and delivering effectively.
Own engineering quality and technical standards across both workflow orchestration and deterministic automation, as well as agentic AI tooling and practices.
Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the team - establishing patterns, evaluating emerging approaches, and building engineering fluency in AI-assisted development at scale.
Partner with Product Owners embedded in each pod to ensure engineers have clear priorities, well-defined work, and the technical context needed to deliver effectively.
Ensure continuous rapid evaluation of automation tooling, frameworks, and agentic patterns, bringing well-reasoned recommendations to leadership and contributing to governance conversations as a technical voice.
Participate in AI governance and definition of responsible AI frameworks, helping to establish standards for how the organization deploys, monitors, and evaluates AI-driven automation in production.
Manage the full engineer lifecycle across the team - hiring, onboarding, performance, growth, and retention - with particular attention to developing engineers in a fast-moving and ambiguous technology domain.
Maintain visibility into pod delivery across all business domains; surface risks, capacity issues, and cross-pod dependencies to leadership before they become blockers.
Represent the AI & Intelligent Automation engineering function in cross-functional conversations with technology leadership, business stakeholders, and vendor partners.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Equivalent experience accepted.
6+ years of experience in technology, engineering, or IT operations, with at least 2 years managing large teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead engineers or technical teams working in fast-moving, ambiguous domains where standards and practices are still being established.
Working knowledge of workflow automation and orchestration concepts - understanding how automated processes are designed, integrated, and maintained in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience with specific platforms is a plus but not required.
Familiarity with AI and agentic automation concepts sufficient to evaluate tooling, guide engineering decisions, and engage credibly with technical teams and leadership. Direct engineering experience in AI is a plus; genuine curiosity and the ability to learn quickly are required.
Experience managing engineers or technical staff across multiple concurrent workstreams, teams, or business domains simultaneously.
Track record of building team culture, engineering standards, or operational practices in environments where they did not fully exist before.
Strong judgment on technology evaluation - able to assess new tools and approaches against real organizational constraints, not just technical appeal.
Comfortable operating at the intersection of team leadership, technical judgment, and strategic contribution.
Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Location: Marlborough/ Chelmsford, MA or Hillsboro, OR

Target Compensation: $180,400 - $216,700

Schedule: 8am- 5pm

That belief has fueled decades of innovation and service, rooted in the tech sector and expanding to support members from all walks of life.

jobs.title: Director of Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

MaxLinear is seeking a Director of Product Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

Build and mentor engineering talent while fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation
Drive seamless transition of products from design to manufacturing and own product manufacturing performance throughout the entire product lifecycle
Lead product bring-up, silicon validation, characterization, qualification, and production release activities
Define organizational strategy, goals, KPIs, and resource plans aligned with company objectives
Collaborate closely with cross functional organizations to optimize performance, yield, testability, and manufacturability
Establish manufacturing readiness criteria and ensure successful product ramp
Own product yield improvement initiatives across wafer fabrication, assembly, and final test operations
Implement statistical process control (SPC), DOE, FMEA, and advanced analytics techniques.
Analyze product and test data to identify yield detractors and implement corrective actions
Develop strategies to improve cost of test, manufacturing efficiency, and overall product margins
Support customer escalations, product quality investigations, and field-return analysis
Establish and manage OSAT scorecards and KPIs to ensure world-class execution in quality, yield, cost, delivery, and cycle time

Qualifications

Experience with releasing products on advanced CMOS Process nodes (16nm and below)
Deep knowledge of mm-wave, RF, Mixed signal and CMOS logic circuit principles
Knowledge and experience with ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), such as Verigy and Teradyne
Experience with Data Analysis S/W such as Galaxy, Data Conductor or DataPower to create Characterization Reports and monitor production Yield
Experience recruiting, managing, and mentoring an engineering team
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 13 years of experience, or MS + 11 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 8 years of experience

Compensation And Benefits

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $ 187,000 to $251 , Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This role will play a critical role in developing and implementing business strategy by managing platform development initiatives from idea creation through deployment including identifying customer need, designing and validating concepts, developing business cases, managing vendor negotiations and relationships, partnering with technology to analyze and write Business and Functional Requirements documentation, managing to a budget SME in coordinating and developing communications with Marketing and Training, coordinating business and Beta testers, and implementing deliverables. Maintains a thorough knowledge of systems and operations processes for platform supported. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining subject matter expertise for platform functionality and resolving chronic service delivery or platform issues identified by client service/support organizations. Serve as primary liaison with Program Owners, Business Channel leaders, SMEs, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Legal, Compliance Risk, and external suppliers/vendors. Associates tend to work more autonomously than their lower-level platform development counterparts. Responsible for hiring, managing, training and developing other Sr platform development managers or platform development managers.

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

LOB Job Description:

This job is responsible for defining and maintaining an operational technology strategy that supports the organization's strategic process transformation objectives. Key responsibilities include translating complex operational workflows into normalized "Process Objects", aligning business needs to enterprise capabilities, maintaining process and capability taxonomies, and enabling horizontal solutions designed across business functions. The Senior Platform Manager facilitates a translation layer between operational subject matter experts, process design teams, enterprise architecture, and technology partners, ensuring business requirements are defined and articulated independently of the systems currently used to execute them.

Job expectations include working across business, operations, technology, and transformation teams to evaluate operational needs, identify reusable capability patterns, develop enterprise knowledge capture assets, and support future-state solution design. The role requires balancing operational fluency with architectural literacy while remaining neutral to specific technologies, platforms, or implementation.

Background in agile delivery and software testing
Ability to communicate fluently across business and technology domains
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

MBA and/or 5+ years of relevant experience leading technology change within an operation

jobs.description:
The Sr. Manager, Emerging Technology is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, performance, and continuous improvement of NEEA’s product management function to advance long-term market transformation outcomes in the Northwest. This role establishes the vision, goals, and operating framework for how emerging technologies are identified, developed, and progressed through the product lifecycle, ensuring alignment with product group strategies, program objectives, and organizational priorities.

The Sr. Manager leads and develops a team of product management professionals, oversees resource allocation and budget execution, and plays a central role in fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners to enable effective, coordinated advancement of product pathways.

Success in this role requires strong leadership and organizational judgment, the ability to set direction and align resources across complex priorities, and the ability to translate strategic goals into sustained performance through teams operating in dynamic and evolving market environments

This position is based in the Portland, OR metro area, with a hybrid work location. We are looking for candidates who can meet the requirement of working at least 3 days per week onsite at NEEA’s office location.
Finalists must have eligibility to work in the US as NEEA is not able to provide VISA sponsorship or have remote work outside of the US.

Salary range: $155,000 - $170,000, exempt

Salary is based on the applicants Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.

The Typical Day May Include…

Define and lead the strategy, priorities, and performance of the Emerging Technology and Product Management function to support NEEA’s long‑term market transformation objectives.
Establish and maintain the operating framework, processes, and standards for product management from technology identification through market adoption, ensuring consistent, high‑quality execution across product areas.
Set direction for how resources, capabilities, and initiatives are aligned to support product strategy development, validation, and portfolio outcomes.
Lead and develop a team of product management professionals, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and capability development to ensure sustained organizational effectiveness.
Oversee and direct the planning, execution, and performance of the Emerging Technology portfolio, including budget management, resource allocation, and delivery of business outcomes.
Guide cross‑functional alignment among product management, program management, and market strategy teams to ensure integrated planning, coordinated execution, and effective use of organizational resources.
Represent NEEA’s Emerging Technology and Product Management interests in regional and national forums to influence collaboration, partnerships, and approaches to advancing the energy efficiency pipeline.
Establish and maintain strategic relationships with external stakeholders, including funders, industry organizations, and partners, to support alignment, information exchange, and long‑term impact.
Monitor and assess emerging market, technology, and organizational trends and adjust functional strategy to address evolving opportunities and risks.
Ensure clear communication of strategy, priorities, performance, and outcomes to senior leadership, stakeholders, and funders
Perform other duties which may be necessary or desirable to support the organization’s success.

Supervisory Responsibilities

As a first-line supervisor, responsibilities include hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

jobs.title: Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

As the Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations, you will lead the global operating model and technical foundation that enables Lifecycle Marketing to deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences at scale.

You will oversee global Lifecycle Operations while serving as the primary Lifecycle business owner for our customer engagement and orchestration platform and the broader technology and data ecosystem that powers customer engagement. Today, Braze sits at the center of that ecosystem. You will define platform strategy and stewardship; journey and campaign operations; customer data and audience capabilities; personalization and decisioning; governance; automation; capacity; and partner delivery. This will build capabilities that can scale globally while supporting the needs of individual regions and markets.

Sitting at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Technology, Data, Product, and Operations, this role combines ownership of the technical foundation that powers Lifecycle with leadership of the operating model that brings it to life. You will partner closely with Marketing, Martech, Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, and regional teams, serving as the connective tissue among customer strategy, platform capabilities, data, and execution.

You will bring strong operational leadership with meaningful technical depth and experience operating at a global scale. You will help build the next stage of Lifecycle Marketing by building a high-performing global operation, shaping the Lifecycle technology roadmap, evolving our customer engagement and orchestration capabilities, diagnosing data and platform issues, and creating processes that enable global strategies to be efficiently localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory environments.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Lifecycle Technology & Platform Leadership

Serve as the primary Lifecycle business owner and technical subject-matter expert for Braze and the broader Lifecycle technology ecosystem, with deep working knowledge of Braze Canvas and campaign architecture, Liquid, Catalogs, Connected Content and API integrations, segmentation, personalization, experimentation, channel configuration, and AI-enabled decisioning and orchestration capabilities; own platform strategy, governance, configuration standards, roadmap priorities, tooling, consumption, and ongoing platform health.
Partner directly with Martech, Product, Engineering, and Data Engineering to define and operationalize the events, attributes, APIs, data contracts, and integrations required to build trigger-based Lifecycle journeys in Braze, including API-based ingestion and utilization of content and metadata to power real-time, contextually relevant intervention messaging across global and regional teams.
Serve as Lifecycle’s dedicated partner to the Braze Technical Account team, leading enhancement discovery, technical recommendations, platform adoption, and roadmap planning; translate emerging Braze and AI capabilities into prioritized use cases and regularly share roadmap implications, recommendations, and enablement guidance with cross-functional Lifecycle Directors and Leadership.
Establish best practices for journey architecture, event-driven messaging, segmentation, channel orchestration, experimentation, personalization, and reusable platform capabilities.
Maintain a strong understanding of how our customer engagement and orchestration platform connects to Product, customer data platforms, content systems, analytics, reporting, and downstream destinations, and identify opportunities to improve or simplify the ecosystem.

Global Lifecycle Operations

Lead the global operating model supporting Lifecycle teams and programs across regions and markets, including subscription journeys and automations, regional marketing, ecommerce, games, manga, theatrical, events, and the broader Crunchyroll fan ecosystem.
Own the end-to-end operational process from intake and prioritization through audience development, campaign and journey build, QA, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
Build scalable campaign and journey operations that allow global strategies and capabilities to be efficiently adapted and localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory requirements while maintaining speed, quality, and consistency.
Build and continuously improve a flexible delivery model across internal teams, regional resources, agency partners, offshore resources, specialized technical expertise, and automation.
Establish clear standards for prioritization, capacity management, development, QA, launch readiness, documentation, incident management, and operational performance—continually improving speed, quality, reliability, and efficiency.

Lifecycle Data, Audiences & Personalization

Own Lifecycle Marketing requirements for the events, attributes, audiences, preferences, behavioral signals, content data, and other customer inputs needed to power personalized experiences across markets.
Partner with CDI, Data Engineering, Martech, Product, and Analytics to identify data gaps, improve signal quality and observability, and prioritize instrumentation and integration needs.
Enable increasingly sophisticated audience creation, behavioral triggers, content affinity, personalization, decisioning, and next-best-action capabilities that can be applied globally while allowing for regional and market-level relevance.
Translate customer and marketing strategies into clear data and technical requirements and help ensure Lifecycle-critical data is reliable, measurable, and fit for purpose.

Governance, Automation & Scale

Reimagine and maintain global governance for customer communications, including messaging hierarchy, prioritization, frequency management, consent and preferences, suppression logic, and cross-channel coordination.
Define scalable global standards for campaign quality, approvals, deliverability, accessibility, localization readiness, documentation, and operational controls, while accommodating market-specific requirements where needed.
Identify and implement practical applications of automation and AI across audience creation, journey development, QA, personalization, content production, workflow management, reporting, and knowledge management.
Continuously evaluate new platform capabilities and emerging technologies, helping move high-value opportunities from pilots into repeatable, scalable solutions across markets.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

Build, develop, and lead a high-performing Lifecycle Technology & Operations team with strong capabilities across platform enablement, journey development, campaign operations, data quality, and operational governance.
Manage agency and external partner performance across quality, throughput, cost, technical capability, service levels, and continuous improvement, building partners toward greater autonomy and accountability.
Serve as a key connector between global Lifecycle Marketing, regional teams, and technical partners, translating marketing ambition into technical requirements while helping marketers understand platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.
Influence cross-functional technology and data roadmaps by clearly articulating Lifecycle use cases, customer impact, regional requirements, dependencies, operational needs, and measurable business value.

In the role of Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations, you will report to the VP, Lifecycle Marketing.

We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

10+ years of experience across Lifecycle Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, customer engagement platforms, or related disciplines within a scaled consumer business.
5+ years of experience leading teams, complex marketing operations, or technical marketing programs, including management of internal and external resources.
Demonstrated experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Martech, or marketing operations across multiple regions and markets, including building global capabilities that support localization, regional requirements, and market-specific execution.
Deep experience with Braze or a comparable customer engagement and orchestration platform, including journey orchestration, segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, experimentation, and multi-channel execution.
Experience serving as a platform owner, senior business stakeholder, or highly technical operator responsible for how a customer engagement or marketing automation platform is configured, governed, used, and evolved.
Strong technical fluency across customer data architecture, events, attributes, audiences, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, identity, and data-quality monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer and marketing needs into technical requirements, platform capabilities, roadmaps, and scalable solutions.
Experience partnering closely with MarTech, Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and regional teams to deliver new customer-facing and operational capabilities.
Proven experience designing and improving global operating models, including intake, prioritization, resource and capacity management, QA, governance, deployment, and incident management.
Experience managing agencies, offshore teams, vendors, budgets, and technology or platform investments.
Strong understanding of customer-contact governance, deliverability, suppression logic, consent and preference management, privacy, and operational risk across complex markets.
Demonstrated success advancing personalization, automation, experimentation, decisioning, or real-time customer engagement capabilities.
Ability to move comfortably between marketing, operational, data, and technical conversations and translate complex concepts for different audiences.
Strong cross-functional leadership, influencing, program management, and problem-solving skills within complex, matrixed, global organizations.
Experience within streaming, subscription, entertainment, gaming, ecommerce, media, or another high-volume digital consumer business is strongly preferred.
Experience applying AI or emerging marketing technologies to improve scale, efficiency, or customer experience is strongly preferred.
Passion for anime, entertainment, or fandom-driven businesses is a plus.

About The Team

Lifecycle Marketing is part of Crunchyroll’s broader Growth organization and is responsible for building deeper, more relevant relationships with fans throughout their journey with Crunchyroll.

Our team works globally across membership engagement and retention, regional title marketing, ecommerce, games, manga, theatrical, events, and other parts of the Crunchyroll fan experience. jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

As the Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations, you will lead the global operating model and technical foundation that enables Lifecycle Marketing to deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences at scale.

You will oversee global Lifecycle Operations while serving as the primary Lifecycle business owner for our customer engagement and orchestration platform and the broader technology and data ecosystem that powers customer engagement. Today, Braze sits at the center of that ecosystem. You will define platform strategy and stewardship; journey and campaign operations; customer data and audience capabilities; personalization and decisioning; governance; automation; capacity; and partner delivery. This will build capabilities that can scale globally while supporting the needs of individual regions and markets.

Sitting at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Technology, Data, Product, and Operations, this role combines ownership of the technical foundation that powers Lifecycle with leadership of the operating model that brings it to life. You will partner closely with Marketing, Martech, Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, and regional teams, serving as the connective tissue among customer strategy, platform capabilities, data, and execution.

You will bring strong operational leadership with meaningful technical depth and experience operating at a global scale. You will help build the next stage of Lifecycle Marketing by building a high-performing global operation, shaping the Lifecycle technology roadmap, evolving our customer engagement and orchestration capabilities, diagnosing data and platform issues, and creating processes that enable global strategies to be efficiently localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory environments.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Lifecycle Technology & Platform Leadership

Serve as the primary Lifecycle business owner and technical subject-matter expert for Braze and the broader Lifecycle technology ecosystem, with deep working knowledge of Braze Canvas and campaign architecture, Liquid, Catalogs, Connected Content and API integrations, segmentation, personalization, experimentation, channel configuration, and AI-enabled decisioning and orchestration capabilities; own platform strategy, governance, configuration standards, roadmap priorities, tooling, consumption, and ongoing platform health.
Partner directly with Martech, Product, Engineering, and Data Engineering to define and operationalize the events, attributes, APIs, data contracts, and integrations required to build trigger-based Lifecycle journeys in Braze, including API-based ingestion and utilization of content and metadata to power real-time, contextually relevant intervention messaging across global and regional teams.
Serve as Lifecycle’s dedicated partner to the Braze Technical Account team, leading enhancement discovery, technical recommendations, platform adoption, and roadmap planning; translate emerging Braze and AI capabilities into prioritized use cases and regularly share roadmap implications, recommendations, and enablement guidance with cross-functional Lifecycle Directors and Leadership.
Establish best practices for journey architecture, event-driven messaging, segmentation, channel orchestration, experimentation, personalization, and reusable platform capabilities.
Maintain a strong understanding of how our customer engagement and orchestration platform connects to Product, customer data platforms, content systems, analytics, reporting, and downstream destinations, and identify opportunities to improve or simplify the ecosystem.

Global Lifecycle Operations

Lead the global operating model supporting Lifecycle teams and programs across regions and markets, including subscription journeys and automations, regional marketing, ecommerce, games, manga, theatrical, events, and the broader Crunchyroll fan ecosystem.
Own the end-to-end operational process from intake and prioritization through audience development, campaign and journey build, QA, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
Build scalable campaign and journey operations that allow global strategies and capabilities to be efficiently adapted and localized across markets, languages, channels, and regulatory requirements while maintaining speed, quality, and consistency.
Build and continuously improve a flexible delivery model across internal teams, regional resources, agency partners, offshore resources, specialized technical expertise, and automation.
Establish clear standards for prioritization, capacity management, development, QA, launch readiness, documentation, incident management, and operational performance—continually improving speed, quality, reliability, and efficiency.

Lifecycle Data, Audiences & Personalization

Own Lifecycle Marketing requirements for the events, attributes, audiences, preferences, behavioral signals, content data, and other customer inputs needed to power personalized experiences across markets.
Partner with CDI, Data Engineering, Martech, Product, and Analytics to identify data gaps, improve signal quality and observability, and prioritize instrumentation and integration needs.
Enable increasingly sophisticated audience creation, behavioral triggers, content affinity, personalization, decisioning, and next-best-action capabilities that can be applied globally while allowing for regional and market-level relevance.
Translate customer and marketing strategies into clear data and technical requirements and help ensure Lifecycle-critical data is reliable, measurable, and fit for purpose.

Governance, Automation & Scale

Reimagine and maintain global governance for customer communications, including messaging hierarchy, prioritization, frequency management, consent and preferences, suppression logic, and cross-channel coordination.
Define scalable global standards for campaign quality, approvals, deliverability, accessibility, localization readiness, documentation, and operational controls, while accommodating market-specific requirements where needed.
Identify and implement practical applications of automation and AI across audience creation, journey development, QA, personalization, content production, workflow management, reporting, and knowledge management.
Continuously evaluate new platform capabilities and emerging technologies, helping move high-value opportunities from pilots into repeatable, scalable solutions across markets.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

Build, develop, and lead a high-performing Lifecycle Technology & Operations team with strong capabilities across platform enablement, journey development, campaign operations, data quality, and operational governance.
Manage agency and external partner performance across quality, throughput, cost, technical capability, service levels, and continuous improvement, building partners toward greater autonomy and accountability.

Influence cross-functional technology and data roadmaps by clearly articulating Lifecycle use cases, customer impact, regional requirements, dependencies, operational needs, and measurable business value.

In the role of Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations, you will report to the VP, Lifecycle Marketing.

We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

10+ years of experience across Lifecycle Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, customer engagement platforms, or related disciplines within a scaled consumer business.
5+ years of experience leading teams, complex marketing operations, or technical marketing programs, including management of internal and external resources.
Demonstrated experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Martech, or marketing operations across multiple regions and markets, including building global capabilities that support localization, regional requirements, and market-specific execution.
Deep experience with Braze or a comparable customer engagement and orchestration platform, including journey orchestration, segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, experimentation, and multi-channel execution.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Operations - Technology Strategy & Roadmap based in United States.

This is a strategic technology leadership role focused on shaping the multi-year technology roadmap for a high-volume commercial support organization.

You will translate business priorities and operating-model needs into technology capabilities spanning data systems, reporting, automation, workflow tools, and commercial platforms.

The role combines strategic planning, roadmap development, stakeholder alignment, investment prioritization, and technology-enabled business transformation.

You will work closely with Technology, Data, Product, Commercial, and enterprise teams to evaluate opportunities, dependencies, risks, and business value.

Your recommendations will help leadership make informed decisions about technology investments, modernization, sequencing, and scalable adoption.

The position offers significant cross-functional visibility and requires strong influence, structured thinking, and the ability to turn complex information into clear executive decisions.

You will also establish value-realization frameworks and transition strategies that help move technology initiatives from strategic planning through implementation and operational adoption.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering data systems, reporting platforms, automation, workflow tools, and commercial support capabilities.
Translate business strategy, operating-model requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clearly sequenced technology capabilities, roadmap themes, and delivery recommendations.
Lead annual and quarterly technology planning processes, evaluating demand, capacity, dependencies, risks, expected benefits, and overall business value.
Assess current-state tools, reporting environments, workflows, and data systems to identify modernization opportunities, simplification requirements, and future capability gaps.
Partner with Technology, Data, Product, platform, and business leaders to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards, architecture patterns, platform direction, and operational requirements.
Prepare executive-ready roadmap materials, decision frameworks, investment recommendations, prioritization options, and supporting analysis for senior leadership.
Serve as a strategic bridge between business leaders, technology partners, data teams, product teams, reporting teams, platform owners, and external vendors.
Facilitate roadmap planning and prioritization forums, aligning stakeholders around business value, technical dependencies, resources, timelines, risks, and trade-offs.
Develop clear decision materials that communicate available options, anticipated impacts, dependencies, and recommended next steps across diverse stakeholder groups.
Influence internal and external partners to advance roadmap priorities, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment between technology planning and commercial strategy.
Lead current-state and future-state assessments across reporting, automation, workflow, data, and commercial support platforms.
Develop KPI and value-realization frameworks to track roadmap progress, adoption, operational impact, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Create transition planning materials that support the movement of roadmap initiatives from strategy into delivery, implementation, adoption, and ongoing operational support.
Coordinate cross-functional technology initiatives while maintaining strong prioritization, governance, communication, and accountability.

Requirements

At least 7 years of professional work experience.

Strong understanding of technology planning, prioritization, business value assessment, dependencies, risks, and investment trade-offs.
Strong partner-management skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong prioritization, team management, communication, and stakeholder-influence capabilities.
Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear recommendations to senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree, or an Associate’s degree plus 6+ years of technology-related experience, or a high school diploma/GED plus 12+ years of technology-related experience.
Five or more years of professional experience in Technology or a related field is preferred.
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Comfortable operating in a highly cross-functional environment where priorities, dependencies, and technology needs may evolve.

Annual incentive: Eligibility to participate in an annual incentive/bonus plan, subject to applicable plan terms and conditions.

jobs.description:
What you will do:

As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end-to-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. You will partner directly with the Digital Marketing organization, EDT business partners, Marketing Operations, and external system integrators to drive scalable content authoring, content globalization, comprehensive campaign insights, and modern cloud architecture across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), and integrated Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities. Additionally, you will lead a team of full-time employees and managed-service partners spanning AEM technical architects, backend/frontend developers, DevOps engineers, QA, and analytics consultants, ensuring the platform delivers on brand consistency, speed-to-market, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experience objectives aligned with Stryker's Mission.

Own the end-to-end AEMaaCS platform strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), Dynamic Media, Multi-Site Manager (MSM), and the AEM Translation Integration Framework (TIF).
Lead architecture governance for the component library, page templates, blueprint/live-copy configurations, and language-copy rollouts supporting Stryker.com and 50+ country sites.
Drive modernization efforts (e.g., AMS-to-AEMaaCS migration, technical debt reduction, out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption) to enable scalable content authoring, globalization, and advanced marketing analytics.
Ensure seamless integration between AEM and adjacent platforms including Workfront, Adobe Analytics, Adobe WebSDK, Marketo, Adobe Target, and Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Oversee CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, release management, and the AEM Releases & Deployment Schedule in partnership with DevOps and system integrators.
Partner with the AEM AI initiative team to evaluate and operationalize built-in generative AI capabilities (content creation, asset tagging, experimentation) in alignment with Stryker's AI Operating Committee (AIOC) governance and residual-risk approvals.
Ensure platform compliance with Stryker IT QMS, SOX, CSV, Global Change Control, privacy/consent regulations, and cybersecurity standards.
Execute a robust talent offense by attracting, developing, retaining, and engaging top talent while driving personal/professional growth of individuals and the team, delivering high-quality results with passion, energy, and drive.
Manage a team consisting of full-time employees, contractors, and managed-service partners; define roles and responsibilities, plan for the department's future needs, counsel employees on performance, and contribute to employee pay decisions or changes.
Lead and mentor Solution Leads, Technical Leads, and Solution Analysts across build and run teams (onshore and offshore).
Serve as the EDT single point of accountability for the AEM platform to Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Corporate Communications, and Divisional marketing stakeholders.
Own program schedules, work breakdown structures, and integrated Gantt/roadmap views for the AEM portfolio.
Implement quality, risk, and procurement management strategies and templates for AEM projects and programs.
Ensure smooth build-to-run transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations.

What you need:

Required:

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of professional experience in IT and/or digital application development, including people leadership experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience delivering and operating Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x and/or AEMaaCS) solutions in a global enterprise environment.
5+ years of experience leading MSM/translation strategies, DAM architecture, component-based design, and Adobe WebSDK integrations.
2+ years of experience with track record managing global system integrators and hybrid onshore/offshore delivery models.
2+ years of experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Real-Time CDP, Commerce) preferred.
5+ years of experience with SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and IT QMS/regulatory compliance (SOX, privacy, consent).

Preferred:

Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Adobe Certified Expert / Master (AEM Sites, AEM Assets, or AEM Architect) strongly preferred.
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification preferred.
Prior experience in medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry preferred.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide.

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio.

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.

What You'll Do

Define and Implement Security Strategy

Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems.
Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Engineering, Platform, and Security leaders, helping drive innovation, customer trust, and business growth.
Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security.

Drive Systemic Risk Reduction

Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices.
Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation.
Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture.

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era

Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms.
Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences.
Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale.

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization

Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams.
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Strengthen Customer Trust

Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle.
Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.
Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust.

What You'll Bring

Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies.
Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities.
Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.
Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services.

Leadership Characteristics

The successful candidate will:

Create the Future by enabling secure innovation and helping Adobe capitalize on emerging technologies.
Own the Outcome by driving meaningful improvements in security, trust, and organizational effectiveness.
Set a higher standard through technical excellence, operational rigor, and talent development.

jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities

Team and organizational leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to managers and senior engineers.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Define and execute the TDP SQL strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP SQL and its partner teams.
Increase platform adoption by reducing integration complexity and delivering well-supported, production-ready capabilities.

Reliability and customer trust

Own the operational health of TDP SQL, including availability, durability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure the platform supports enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and regulated environments.
Maintain clear visibility into customer commitments and intervene when delivery or reliability risks threaten those outcomes.

Technical and platform leadership

Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the platform’s evolution across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, tenant isolation, migration safety, security, operability, and reversibility.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with dependent infrastructure and customer teams.

Cross-functional leadership and economics

Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP SQL in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, and portfolio planning.
Own the platform’s cost posture, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.

Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.

jobs.title: IT Director, Salesforce Platform Owner
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

As IT Director, Salesforce Platform Owner, you will own the vision, roadmap, and governance of Heartflow's Salesforce ecosystem and serve as the executive liaison between IT and the business.

Salesforce at Heartflow supports more than 500 users across Commercial Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Production, and Quality Systems. Because the platform spans both commercial teams and highly regulated functions, this role calls for a leader who can move quickly on revenue-facing priorities while holding the line on compliance and data integrity.

You will act as a thought partner to business function leaders, chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee, reconcile competing departmental priorities, and turn complex business processes into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Roadmap & Governance: Chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee. Act as product owner for the platform, prioritizing investment based on business value, compliance obligations, and ROI, and communicating trade-offs transparently to stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Serve as the primary IT point of contact for department heads. Lead discovery sessions to understand their workflows in depth and translate what you learn into clear business requirements and user stories.
Cross-Functional IT Collaboration: Partner with IT development and platform teams to hand off groomed requirements for execution in an Agile/Scrum model, staying engaged through delivery.
Process Optimization & Adoption: Audit commercial and clinical workflows to find bottlenecks and manual workarounds. Champion adoption, lead User Acceptance Testing, and drive change management for new releases.
Data & Revenue Integrity: Work with business and IT teams to enforce Master Data Management practices, and ensure Salesforce (front office) and NetSuite (back office) stay integrated so data silos and reconciliation gaps don't form.
Compliance & Validation: Ensure platform changes follow Heartflow's change control, SOX, and quality system requirements, partnering with Quality and InfoSec on validation and access governance where applicable.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 8-10+ years in Enterprise Applications, Business Systems, or RevOps, including 3+ years in a Director-level or strategic Product Owner / Business Partner role.
Salesforce Depth: Strong functional and architectural understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud and Service Cloud required; CPQ, Health Cloud, or Revenue Cloud a significant plus).
Stakeholder Management: Be an exceptional communicator with a track record of resolving conflicting priorities and building consensus across departments with different incentives.
Industry Experience: Life Sciences, MedTech, Biotech, or another regulated public company environment (SOX, HIPAA, FDA, quality systems) strongly preferred.
Methodology: Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum and in translating ambiguous business needs into deliverables the IT development team can build.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
