About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the organization’s technology strategy, transformation, and execution.

The ideal candidate will have significant experience in a CTO or comparable executive technology leadership role, with a strong understanding of fintech, device financing, digital platforms, and technology-enabled business models. The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable technology function, driving innovation, improving delivery, and leading the organization toward a more technology-driven platform model.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute the company’s overall technology strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Lead the transformation of the organization into a scalable, technology-enabled platform.
* Oversee the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of technology products and platforms.
* Provide strong leadership to engineering, product, infrastructure, data, and other technology teams.
* Establish a high-performance technology culture focused on ownership, accountability, innovation, and timely delivery.
* Drive the development of secure, scalable, reliable, and customer-focused digital solutions.
* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to identify and implement technology opportunities that drive business growth.
* Translate business objectives into clear technology roadmaps, priorities, and execution plans.

* Establish appropriate technology governance, processes, standards, and performance metrics.
* Manage relationships with technology vendors, partners, and external service providers.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, security, and data protection requirements.
* Manage technology budgets, resources, and investments effectively.
* Identify technology risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Champion continuous improvement and rapid execution across the technology function.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Significant experience in a CTO, VP of Technology, Head of Engineering, or comparable senior technology leadership role.
* Strong experience within fintech, financial services, device financing, lending, payments, or related technology-driven industries.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale technology transformation and delivering complex technology projects.
* Strong understanding of digital platforms, software architecture, APIs, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, data, and modern engineering practices.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing technology teams.
* Strong understanding of product development and the ability to work closely with product and business teams.
* Proven ability to take ownership of technology strategy and execution from concept through delivery.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader who can also execute. You should be comfortable making difficult technology decisions, challenging ideas when necessary, standing your ground with senior stakeholders, and taking full ownership of major technology initiatives.

You must have a proven ability to build teams, own projects, drive delivery, and transform technology into a genuine business growth engine.

Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to hiring@strivolabs.com with “Chief Technology Officer (CTO)” as the subject of the email

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core Engineering, Trusted Data Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities

Team and organizational leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to managers and senior engineers.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Define and execute the TDP SQL strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP SQL and its partner teams.
Increase platform adoption by reducing integration complexity and delivering well-supported, production-ready capabilities.

Reliability and customer trust

Own the operational health of TDP SQL, including availability, durability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure the platform supports enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and regulated environments.
Maintain clear visibility into customer commitments and intervene when delivery or reliability risks threaten those outcomes.

Technical and platform leadership

Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the platform’s evolution across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, tenant isolation, migration safety, security, operability, and reversibility.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with dependent infrastructure and customer teams.

Cross-functional leadership and economics

Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP SQL in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, and portfolio planning.
Own the platform’s cost posture, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Role

, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A
: $209,700 - $273,775

Zone B
: $188,730 - $246,398

Zone C
: $174,051 - $227,233

Qualifications

Significant engineering leadership experience,
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, database platform, storage service, or comparable infrastructure product.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, organizational design, hiring, and succession planning.
Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, security, and operational risk.
Experience delivering enterprise capabilities such as data residency, encryption, compliance, disaster recovery, or tenant isolation.
Proven ability to lead incident response and convert operational learning into lasting improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and experience resolving dependencies between organizations with different priorities.
Sound judgment when balancing reliability, strategic alignment, delivery speed, cost, and technical sustainability.
Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.

Experience with managed SQL platforms (TiDB is a plus), distributed relational databases, multi-cloud infrastructure, large-scale migrations, or internal developer platforms is beneficial but not required.

jobs.location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
OSK Holdings Berhad is a conglomerate with diversified business interests in Property, Financial Services, Industries, Hospitality and Investment Holding. Founded on principles of innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the Group has grown to become a significant player in both the local and international markets including being the market leader in several industries. Over the years, the Group has expanded its horizons beyond Malaysian borders and established operations in Australia with offerings in financial services and property development.

Job Title: Senior Manager, Business Process Re-Engineering

Location: Plaza OSK, (Jalan Ampang, KL)

ROLE POSITIONING AND OBJECTIVES:

Lead business process re-engineering and transformation initiatives that drive agility, efficiency, and customer-centricity. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on leader who thrives in dynamic environments and is committed to unlocking business value through innovative process design and optimization.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

Champion and lead end-to-end business process transformation across departments, aligning operations with strategic goals and future-ready capabilities.
Conduct deep-dive diagnostics including process mapping, gap analysis, and root cause identification to uncover inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

Develop compelling business cases and transformation roadmaps for senior leadership, articulating value creation and impact.
Apply structured methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Business Process Re-engineering to drive data-driven decision-making and scalable solutions.
Stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in process excellence and digital transformation.
Provide leadership and oversight for business process re-engineering & transformation initiatives while serving as the alternate and backup to the Head of BPR & Transformation.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
CBPRP and/or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) certification is highly desirable.
Proven success in leading complex transformation programs and re-engineering initiatives with measurable outcomes.

in process re-engineering, operational excellence, or transformation roles.

jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Oceanfront elegance within an iconic social club setting. From the moment it first opened its doors on New Year’s Eve 1930, The Surf Club has hosted history. It is here that you will find Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club. An icon in the Miami Beaches, located near Sunny Isles, this beachside hotel brings a new era of luxury, with celebrated dining and a world-class spa, to its Surfside shores.

About The Role

The Residential Assistant Director of Engineering forms part of the Residential team who collectively make key strategic and operational decisions for Building, overseeing all engineering operations for interior/exterior facilities including plumbing, refrigeration, heating/cooling, painting, carpentry, structural, recycling, electrical, ground care and parking areas. The Assistant Director of Engineering is also responsible for Life/Fire safety systems, energy/green initiative systems and management of other engineering work necessary to maintain the property in an efficient condition to ensure the safety and comfort of residents and employees. This position supports the Director of Engineering in all aspects of the Residential operation

What You Will Do

Implement preventive maintenance schedules, policies and procedures
Comply with and enforce Four Seasons’ Category One and Category Two Work Rules and Standards of Conduct as set forth in EmPact
Ensure meter readings are taken daily on heat, light and review information to evaluate consumption
Maintain asset register for all equipment
Maintain licenses and permits required by local law for all MEP/plant
Continued oversight and review of reserve study ensuring implementation of strategic plan for all capital reserve expenditures
Actively develop energy conservation program allowing the Residential and Master Associations to meet its annual budget targets
Develop close working relations with outside contractors; engaging as needed for common space maintenance and for resident requests
Assist with maintenance of all fire-fighting equipment and ensures that emergency procedures are understood and practiced by all employees
Prepare annual maintenance plans and forecasts, managing budget
Is seen as a hands-on leader, assists employees in crunch times
Maintains a clean and orderly work area and ensures tools & equipment are well maintained and in sufficient supply
Promotes and ensures a safe working environment
Drive assets lifecycles with preventative maintenance projects, and reduce critical building issues.

What You Bring

Professional degree in an Engineering discipline, trade degree in a specific technical field relating to Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering) or CEOE – Certified Engineering Operations Executive from the Hotel and motel Hospitality Association, Building Owners Management Institution (BOMI) designation, Real Property Administrator (RPA), Facility Management Administrator (FMA) or Systems Maintenance Administrator (SMA)
Experienced in construction phase area to secure retrieval, and filing of construction documents, permits, licensing, feasibility studies, and manuals, mechanical, electrical, wiring diagrams, hydraulics, blueprint updates, and testing and storage of necessary equipment and material pars, etc.
5+ years’ experience
Hotsos experience a plus

What We Offer

Excellent Training and Development opportunities
Complimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resort
Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours

Full Time (Days, Evenings, Weekends, Holidays and Overnight)

Candidates must have valid work authorization for the U.S.

Meta is seeking an experienced leader to join our Global Security – Systems and Technology (GSST) team. GSST manages and advances the state of physical security technology and building systems through strategy, design, and innovation. The Core Technology leader will drive impact across Meta's global offices, retail, data centers, and non-traditional site portfolio through technical design, scalable processes, tool development, and business acumen that together enable an efficient and durable technology stack.The ideal candidate brings deep command of technology design and uses it to guide and influence scalable solutions — both technology and non-technology — across Meta's physical environment. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core Engineering, Trusted Data Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities

Team and organizational leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to managers and senior engineers.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Define and execute the TDP SQL strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP SQL and its partner teams.
Increase platform adoption by reducing integration complexity and delivering well-supported, production-ready capabilities.

Reliability and customer trust

Own the operational health of TDP SQL, including availability, durability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure the platform supports enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and regulated environments.
Maintain clear visibility into customer commitments and intervene when delivery or reliability risks threaten those outcomes.

Technical and platform leadership

Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the platform’s evolution across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, tenant isolation, migration safety, security, operability, and reversibility.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with dependent infrastructure and customer teams.

Cross-functional leadership and economics

Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP SQL in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, and portfolio planning.
Own the platform’s cost posture, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States
, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A
: $209,700 - $273,775

Zone B
: $188,730 - $246,398

Zone C
: $174,051 - $227,233

Qualifications

Significant engineering leadership experience,
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, database platform, storage service, or comparable infrastructure product.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, organizational design, hiring, and succession planning.
Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, security, and operational risk.
Experience delivering enterprise capabilities such as data residency, encryption, compliance, disaster recovery, or tenant isolation.
Proven ability to lead incident response and convert operational learning into lasting improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and experience resolving dependencies between organizations with different priorities.
Sound judgment when balancing reliability, strategic alignment, delivery speed, cost, and technical sustainability.
Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.

Experience with managed SQL platforms (TiDB is a plus), distributed relational databases, multi-cloud infrastructure, large-scale migrations, or internal developer platforms is beneficial but not required.

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits
.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Location: Bellevue, WA

The Experience

The Authentication Platform Engineering Manager leads the team responsible for the core identity services that power Salesforce's production infrastructure, including Kerberos-based authentication, Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP), and Fast Identity Online 2 (FIDO2) systems. This role sits at the heart of our Production Identity and Access Management (IAM) stack, ensuring every access request across our global fleet is secure, authenticated, and resilient. You will manage a team of specialists who bridge legacy infrastructure protocols and modern, cloud-native identity standards to defend against sophisticated threats.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive the strategy and execution for the Authentication Platform, ensuring these foundational services scale horizontally across diverse environments.
Provide technical leadership across a diverse protocol stack, from Kerberos and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) to modern WebAuthn/FIDO2 and TOTP implementations.
Guarantee the reliability of services that are foundational dependencies for the entire company, targeting high availability standards.
Partner with security architects to implement Zero Trust principles, ensuring the platform enforces strict adherence to least privilege and robust identity verification.
Develop each engineer's ability to work effectively in an AI-augmented environment, moving beyond tracking output to actively coaching growth into higher-level system design and architecture work.
Own how AI tools are integrated into the team's daily development cycle, including configuration, feedback loops, and the judgment calls about when human review is required to validate output.
Serve as the guardian of architectural integrity, security best practices, and technical standards as AI increases code volume, coaching engineers to critically audit AI-generated code for logic flaws, vulnerabilities, and performance issues.

You're Our Person If...

You have 13+ years of software engineering experience, including 3-5 years leading teams in high-pressure, infrastructure-centric environments.
You have proven expertise in Kerberos and identity protocols such as Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and LDAP.
You have experience managing systems with massive throughput and high-availability requirements in public cloud (AWS/GCP) or hybrid environments.
You're familiar with Java, Go, or C#, and have experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and modern continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
You have active, hands-on proficiency with AI development tools; full utilization is the baseline expectation, along with deep technical expertise sufficient to evaluate architectural integrity and make informed decisions about AI-generated output.
You have experience assessing candidates on their ability to formulate effective prompts, evaluate AI outputs, and orchestrate multi-agent workflows in addition to foundational technical skills.

Even Better If...

You have experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade Identity Providers (IdP) or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) platforms.
You understand hardware security modules (HSMs), public key infrastructure (PKI), and secure credential storage.
You have knowledge of how authentication systems meet Payment Card Industry (PCI), SOC2, or Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements.
You have experience managing on-call rotations for high-visibility production services, and a track record of hiring and growing senior engineering talent.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re a cloud technology company that provides organizations around the world with computing infrastructure and software to help them innovate, unlock efficiencies, and become more effective. We also created the world’s first and only autonomous database to help organize and secure our customers’ data.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure offers higher performance, security, and cost savings. It is designed so businesses can move workloads easily from on-premises systems to the cloud, and between cloud and on-premises and other clouds. Oracle Cloud applications provide business leaders with modern applications that help them innovate, attain sustainable growth, and become more resilient.

The work we do is not only transforming the world of business--it is helping defend governments, advance scientific and medical research, and power critical AI workloads at global scale. From nonprofits to companies of all sizes, millions of people use our tools to connect data, applications, and intelligence around the world.

As Senior Director, Multimodal GenAI and Infrastructure Management, you will lead a high-impact organization responsible for advancing Oracle’s multimodal GenAI strategy and ensuring the infrastructure, capacity, reliability, governance, and operating model needed to deliver those capabilities at scale. You will partner across applied science, engineering, product, security, finance, operations, and executive stakeholders to translate research and customer needs into secure, reliable, cost-effective AI services.

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

Strategic Leadership: Set the long-range roadmap, and operating model for multimodal GenAI services and supporting infrastructure. Align investments with Oracle Cloud priorities, customer demand, model capability roadmaps, capacity plans, and executive business objectives.
Multimodal GenAI Platform Direction: Lead development and delivery of capabilities spanning large language models, vision-language models, image and video understanding/generation, speech/audio, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, safety systems, and model lifecycle tooling.
Infrastructure and Capacity Management: Own planning and execution for the compute, networking, storage, data, inference/training at large scale, orchestration, observability, and GPU/HPC capacity required to support high-volume GenAI workloads. Drive disciplined capacity forecasting, utilization management, and cost controls.

Applied Science and Engineering Execution:
Lead applied scientists, engineers, data specialists, technical program managers, and infrastructure leaders in converting research advances into production-grade services with measurable business and customer impact.

Reliability, Performance, and Operational Excellence: Establish service-level expectations, incident practices, change management, performance benchmarks, and operational dashboards for mission-critical GenAI platforms. Ensure services meet high standards for latency, throughput, availability, scalability, and security.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, engineering, OCI infrastructure, security, legal, finance, data operations, sales, and customer teams to define requirements, resolve dependencies, and deliver end-to-end GenAI solutions.
Governance, Safety, and Responsible AI: Ensure GenAI systems are designed and operated with appropriate controls for data handling, model access, evaluation, safety, privacy, compliance, abuse prevention, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
Customer and Business Impact: Translate strategic customer and internal Oracle needs into scalable platform capabilities. Prioritize initiatives that improve adoption, quality, efficiency, cost-to-serve, and differentiated enterprise value.
Budget, Vendor, and Resource Management: Manage budgets, headcount plans, vendor engagements, consumption forecasts, and cross-charge models for GenAI infrastructure and external dependencies. Make trade-offs across cost, performance, schedule, customer commitments, and risk.
Talent and Organizational Leadership: Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing senior technical organization. Develop leaders, clarify ownership, improve execution discipline, and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, inclusion, and customer focus.
Market and Technology Trends: Stay current on advances in GenAI, multimodal foundation models, AI infrastructure, inference optimization, GPUs/accelerators, open-source ecosystems, and competitive cloud AI offerings. Use these insights to shape Oracle’s roadmap and differentiation.

Preferred Skills And Experience

A Ph.D. or advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent industry leadership experience will be considered.
15+ years of experience in technology leadership, applied science, AI/ML engineering, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or related domains, including significant experience leading large technical organizations.
Proven track record delivering production AI, ML, or cloud infrastructure services at enterprise or hyperscale levels, with accountability for reliability, cost, performance, and customer adoption.
Deep understanding of generative AI architectures, multimodal models, model serving, inference optimization, data pipelines, evaluation systems, RAG, prompt/model safety, and ML lifecycle management.
Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, GPU/HPC capacity, networking, storage, observability, platform operations, security, and service management for high-scale workloads.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex budgets, capacity plans, vendor dependencies, and executive-level trade-offs in environments with rapidly changing demand and technical requirements.
Exceptional leadership skills, including hiring, developing, and leading senior managers, principal engineers, scientists, and cross-functional teams through ambiguity and high-pressure execution.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical strategy to customer outcomes, cost structure, risk management, and Oracle’s broader cloud and AI objectives.
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and infrastructure concepts to technical, business, finance, legal, and customer audiences.
High judgment, ownership, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, large-scale dependencies, and mission-critical customer expectations.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

The Sr. Director, Pre-Si System Validation leads AMD's system-level modeling — including emulation — and pre-silicon validation for Data Center GPU platforms. This role ensures early, system-accurate insights across AI, HPC, and cloud-scale environments, accelerating software readiness, reducing integration risk, and enabling end-to-end HW/SW co-design. It drives holistic evaluation of GPU SoCs, platforms, and rack-scale systems ahead of silicon availability.

Operating at the center of DCGPU execution, the individual partners with architecture, silicon, systems, software, performance, and customer teams, while engaging senior leadership and key customers.

The Person

The role owns the end-to-end pre-silicon validation strategy, infrastructure, methodology, and execution across AMD's Instinct™ GPUs, ROCm™ platform, and broader compute ecosystem, with direct interface to executive, CTO, and BU leadership.

Ability to translate complex technical insights into clear, executive-level recommendations.

Track record of operating effectively in fast-paced, high-stakes, and ambiguous environments.
Exceptional communication, influence, and executive presence in cross-functional and external-facing environments.

Key Responsibilities

System-Level Pre-Si Strategy & Ownership

Own the system-level validation strategy and roadmap for Data Center GPU platforms across pre- and post-silicon.
Establish emulation as a core DCGPU execution capability, accelerating architectural confidence, software bring-up, and risk reduction.
Drive investment and prioritization of emulation infrastructure, tooling, and methodologies aligned to DCGPU scale and timelines.

AI, HPC, and Platform-Scale Enablement

Lead simulation and emulation of GPU SoCs, multi-die architectures, and full system platforms for AI training, inference, and HPC workloads.
Enable rack-, pod-, and cluster-level exploration, spanning memory hierarchy, interconnects/fabrics, IO, and platform interactions.
Partner with architecture and performance teams to deliver early system-scale performance, power, and scalability insights.

HW/SW Co-Design & Software Readiness

Drive shift-left HW/SW co-design through high-fidelity modeling including emulation, enabling early access for firmware, drivers, runtime, compilers, and frameworks.
Integrate emulation into software development and validation flows to improve predictability and time-to-value.
Correlate emulation results with workload behavior and performance targets in partnership with performance teams.

Cross-Functional & Executive Engagement

Serve as the executive owner for system-level emulation in architecture, program, and executive reviews.
Partner with platform solutions and customer engineering to ensure system readiness for hyperscalers, CSPs, and enterprise customers.
Represent AMD in strategic customer and partner engagements where system-level validation is a key differentiator.

Execution, Talent, and Organizational Leadership

Build and lead a world-class system-level emulation organization, including senior architects and people leaders.
Establish technical standards, best practices, and governance across emulation, simulation, and hybrid modeling.
Mentor senior technical leaders, strengthening AMD's long-term system modeling and emulation bench.

Proven leadership of large, multi-disciplinary teams at Sr. Director/VP level

Strong knowledge of AI/HPC workloads, GPU architectures, memory, and interconnects

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Department
Technology, Data & AI
About The Team
The Data & Analytics team is Justworks' data and AI center of excellence — a connected set of functions spanning business intelligence, data science, analytics engineering, platform data/ML engineering and AI builders. We've grown significantly over the last several years and continue to build momentum across the business, leveling up maturity in how we deliver insights, govern data, and enable the company to make better decisions. You'll find a highly collaborative & diverse group motivated by craft, shared learning, and a genuine commitment to growing our impact for customers while evolving how we work together for our people. Come build with us!
The Data Platform Engineering team sits at the core of this foundation, owning the pipelines, platform infrastructure, and reliability that every other DNA function depends on.
Who You Are
You're a hands-on engineering leader with deep experience building and operating modern data platforms. You've led teams through scale — evolving architecture, improving reliability, and making hard tradeoffs between speed, cost, and quality. You're as comfortable reviewing a PR or debugging a pipeline failure as you are setting quarterly roadmap priorities or presenting a platform strategy to senior leadership.
You think in systems - how pipelines, orchestration, governance, and observability connect to produce a trustworthy platform - and you know how to build a team that operates with both craft and urgency. You develop engineers, set a high technical bar, and create an environment where people grow.
You bring strong opinions grounded in experience with modern PaaS data stack technologies - Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Estuary - and you've seen what works and what doesn't at scale. Snowflake is core to how we operate and you should have depth there.
Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics, you'll lead the data platform organization, setting technical direction, driving operational excellence, and ensuring the platform is reliable, scalable, and built to support the company's growth.
Your Success Profile
What You Will Work On
Platform Leadership & Technical Direction

Own the technical direction of Justworks' core data platform — pipelines, infrastructure, orchestration, and the standards that keep it trustworthy
Lead architectural decisions on cloud data infrastructure, balancing scalability, cost, reliability, and security
Drive operational excellence across the platform — observability, data quality, cost optimization, incident management, and SLAs
Set and enforce engineering standards — testing, documentation, CI/CD, and code review best practices
Maintain and evolve infrastructure as code, ensuring the platform is auditable, repeatable, and resilient

Team Leadership & Development

Lead and develop a team of data engineers, including direct line managers and individual contributors at various levels
Set a high bar for engineering craft — mentor engineers, conduct architecture reviews, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
Recruit and hire high-caliber data engineers as the platform team grows
Create an environment where engineers develop their skills, take ownership, and do the best work of their careers

Cross-Functional Partnership & Delivery

Partner with DNA functional teams (e.g. Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Science) and distributed Data Engineering teams to ensure the platform serves the full breadth of org needs
Collaborate with other engineering teams to align on data contracts, security, compliance, and shared infrastructure
Drive planning processes that connect platform priorities to DNA's overall strategy and enterprise OKRs

How You Will Do Your Work
As a Sr. Manager, Data Platform Engineering,, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately results in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:
Plans & Aligns

- Ensures individual actions support company mission; communicates effectively; understands urgency and plans accordingly
Balances Stakeholders

- Understands internal and external stakeholder requirements, expectations, and needs and acts fairly despite conflicting demands of stakeholders.
Influence and Leadership

- fostering a community of knowledge-sharing, collaboration, mentorship, and forward-thinking across the organization.
Manages Complexity

- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Good Judgment

- Pauses before acting; asks questions to fully understand context; applies critical thinking and takes ownership of outcomes
Teamwork & Communication

- Honors diverse thoughts and opinions; leverages unique skills to maximize efficiency
Skills and Knowledge

- the capacity to actively learn and apply specific domain knowledge, know-how, and best practices to continually enhance and improve.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:
Camaraderie

- Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
Openness

- Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
Grit

- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
Integrity

- Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. 
Simplicity

- Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Qualifications
You're a builder who applies systems thinking to internal infrastructure. You're comfortable working across a diverse data organization and partnering with leadership to turn fragmented ways of working into scalable, durable systems.
10+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with at least 5 years working hands-on with modern PaaS data stack technologies (Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Estuary, or equivalent)
Deep Snowflake expertise - schema design, query optimization, cost governance, data sharing, and performance tuning at scale
5+ years of engineering management experience, including experience managing managers or leading a multi-team engineering organization
Strong architectural judgment - able to make sound decisions on pipeline design, infrastructure patterns, and platform evolution
Experience leading a distributed engineering team across multiple workstreams and delivery tracks
Deep proficiency in SQL and Python; recognized by peers for technical rigor
Strong expertise with AWS services (S3, Lambda, Fargate, Redshift, Kinesis) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Strong experience with data governance, security, and compliance in a production environment
Excellent communicator — able to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, present platform strategy to senior leadership, and translate infrastructure investments into business terms
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving work forward in a fast-moving environment
Point of view on how AI is changing data platform engineering — both in how the team works and what the platform enables

Nice to have

Experience building data platforms that support ML/AI workloads (feature stores, model pipelines, vector stores)
Background in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment (fintech, HR tech, healthcare)
Experience with streaming/CDC technologies (Estuary, Kafka, Debezium)

Data & Analytics: Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran

Workflow Orchestration: Airflow, MWAA

jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

You will run and own the product engineering organization end to end: their architecture,

delivery,

and

engineering roadmap

. You are here to build and enable an engineering organization that

ships fast and reliably

, and how much of it is AI-efficiently enabled.

How We Work

Business alignment and focus come first.

Engineering here exists to move the business.

Key Performance Indicators

Speed: DORA metrics with High/Elite as the target.
Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software.
AI adoption and its impact.

Responsibilities

Product and delivery

Own architecture design, delivery and engineering roadmap for your teams. Build the partnership with Product: shape it together, commit to it, and then deliver it.
Run delivery on monthly cycles with an explicit cut line. Scope, design and deliver demonstrable value each month. Your teams must have an evidence backed ability to meet commitments rather than explained afterwards.

Organization and people

Design teams that deliver. Draw team boundaries so a team can finish its work without waiting on any other team. One accountable Engineering Manager per team, so the owner of any piece of work is known the moment it arrives.
Build the manager bench. Hire, develop, and calibrate engineering managers, own the hiring bar, and know who is ready to run each team. Coach them to lead rather than code.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ leading engineering teams, and experience leading managers.
Evidence you have made an engineering organization measurably faster. You instrumented DORA or an equivalent, you know your before-and-after numbers, and can walk through what you changed and what broke while it settled.
Real, hands-on AI-assisted engineering at organizational scale, with impact you can quantify. Not a pilot and not a vendor rollout: adoption driven across teams, agentic tooling you use yourself every week, your own harness you can describe, and a clear view of where it fails and what to verify. Bring the evidence: the harness you run, a skill you wrote and shared, a spec an agent executed, the review gates you shipped.
Experience redesigning how teams and work are organized: boundaries, ownership, cadence, and living with the result.
Delivered and modernized complex software through multiple teams, including reassessing scope or dates with senior stakeholders and absorbing the consequences.
Hands-on enough to review a design, read a change and hold a defensible technical position without owning the implementation.
Owned a hiring plan end to end and held a bar; run software in production with real accountability for availability; led remote teams across time zones with vendor squads inside them, on agreements you shaped.
Managed hosting, cloud or another high-availability service business is a must.

Hard Skills

Depth in any single technology matters less than the judgment to specify, verify and decide; AI supplies the syntax and the reference. These are the areas we will test that judgment in.

AI-native engineering. Agentic coding tools as your daily instrument and a harness you designed: repository instructions, shared skills, tool connectors, permission boundaries. Specification-first working, automated review in the pull-request path, a defensible position on what may be auto-approved, and quota and cost governance.
The delivery system. DORA instrumented and moved, tests on every change with coverage gating, trunk-based delivery and feature flags, observability and service levels, one tracker with one intake door, incident command with actions closed on dates.
Long-lived cores. Leading change on twenty-year Perl and PHP monoliths without writing either: strangler seams behind an API gateway, an identity issuer and an event bus, characterization tests before change, a system of record chosen where there are two of everything, and knowing what not to rewrite.
Revenue-bearing systems. Billing and payments consolidation across processors, Stripe among them: dual-run, reconciliation to Finance, and a rollback you prepared.
Hosting platforms. cPanel and InterWorx, the control panel we develop ourselves; WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware above them; Linux on bare metal, and a VMware to Nutanix migration that product delivery has to sequence around.
Security in an AI-assisted SDLC. Secrets hygiene and push protection, static analysis in the merge path, the tool and connector supply chain, prompt injection through repository content.

What We Can Achieve Together

The Managing Director, Data, AI & Applied Technology advances The Nature Conservancy (TNC)'s conservation mission by defining how data, applied technology, and artificial intelligence create measurable mission and business value. This is a newly created role and a first-of-its-kind function at TNC: it owns the “what, who, and why” of data, applied technology, and AI, including what decisions must improve, what outcomes matter most, where data can create mission advantage, and how emerging technologies should be responsibly explored and applied. The role then translates these insights into coordinated, collaborative execution to deliver measurable outcomes.

This role leads enterprise business data strategy, domain data ownership, data governance accountability, responsible AI governance, use-case prioritization, value realization, and adoption, and partners closely with the CIO organization, which owns technical data platforms, architecture, engineering, controls, and scalable delivery.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer with a dotted line to the Chief Executive Officer, and a dotted-line partnership with the Chief Information Officer, the Managing Director serves as TNC's senior authority on business data and AI strategy and governance, applied and emerging conservation technology, the NatureChat and conservation intelligence workstreams, technology partnerships, and external thought leadership and cross-NGO positioning.

In This Role, You Will

Develop and maintain TNC's enterprise business data, applied technology, and AI strategies, aligned to conservation priorities and organizational goals.
Establish and mature a federated domain data ownership model across Conservation, Science, Development/Membership, Marketing, HR, Finance, Legal, Operations, and other enterprise domains.
Lead enterprise data governance from a business accountability perspective, and establish responsible AI governance guidance, acceptable-use expectations, and risk-review processes.
Build executive and domain-leader commitment to data stewardship, data quality, responsible AI, and adoption, and develop data and AI literacy programs in partnership with People, Learning, IT, and business domains.
Build and manage a high-performing, globally aware team spanning business data strategy and governance, responsible AI, portfolio management, adoption, and data culture.
Operate as an enterprise partner and trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, and represent TNC in external forums on responsible AI, conservation data, and mission-driven data strategy.
Manage an annual operating budget covering team, tools, and external services, and negotiate and manage contracts with vendors and service partners.

You will navigate the unique dynamics of a globally federated organization, building consensus across regions and business units while maintaining enterprise standards, and champion a culture where people at every level can confidently use data to make decisions.

We’re Looking For You

Are you energized by the chance to build something that has never existed at TNC before? This is a rare opportunity to shape a brand-new enterprise function from the ground up, one that will define how data, applied technology, and artificial intelligence help protect the lands and waters all life depends on.

You will work at the center of TNC's federated, global structure, partnering with the Chief Operating Officer, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Information Officer, and Executive Leadership Team to translate emerging technology into real conservation and business outcomes. You will help TNC evolve into an organization where timely, trusted data informs decisions at every level, from field-based conservation teams to the executive suite.

If you thrive on ambiguity, enjoy building consensus across a complex global organization, and want your work on data and AI to translate directly into mission impact, we would love to hear from you. This position is hybrid, with a preference for candidates based in the Washington, DC metro area near TNC's Arlington, VA office, though flexibility exists for candidates located elsewhere.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's degree in business, law, data science, data governance, natural resource management, or other relevant field and 10 or more years of experience, including 5 years of experience at a senior level in a global and/or multi-product line organization, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in partnership development with corporations, community leaders, governments, and non-profit organizations in multiple countries, including experience with high-level government and conservation contacts.
Experience translating organizational strategy into data, analytics, applied technology, or AI-enabled business outcomes.
Experience with executive-level communication and influence, including building credibility with non-technical senior audiences and technical partners.
Experience leading governance, decision rights, adoption strategies, change management, and benefits realization across a matrixed organization.
Experience with data privacy, security, ethical data use, responsible AI, and inclusive change leadership.

Desired Qualifications

Graduate degree in business, law, data science, data governance, natural resource management, and/or other relevant field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in global, federated, or mission-driven organizations.
Experience establishing federated data governance, responsible AI governance, domain data ownership, or data product operating models.
Familiarity with conservation science data, geospatial data, fundraising or donor data, marketing data, HR or people data, finance data, or comparable complex data domains.
Track record building organizational data literacy and adoption, encompassing culture and behavior change, not just tools.
Experience cultivating external technology partnerships, academic collaborations, in-kind support, or pro bono expertise.
Comfort with ambiguity and an entrepreneurial approach, including experience shaping a new enterprise function while maintaining governance discipline.

Salary Information

This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $275,000 - $330,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range includes flexibility depending on experience and unique skill sets. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate’s qualifications, specific skills, and experience.

Who We Are

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

Introduction

The VP, Software Engineering is responsible for realizing product vision across one or more of Optimizely's core product lines or broad cross-cutting horizontals — with a sharp focus on how AI shapes how we build, operate, and continuously improve. They also own the internal operating model for Engineering: how we run, how we measure ourselves, and how we get better over time.

They balance technical depth with a bias toward execution, process, and delivery. They are strong collaborators who build cross-organizational consensus, negotiate priorities, share information openly, and drive broad initiatives to meet commitments. They act as leaders and active participants in company-wide efforts that deliver business value and drive continuous improvement, and serve as exemplars of Optimizely's values.

Champions the adoption of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) across engineering teams, establishing clear standards, enablement programs, and measurable impact metrics.
Drives the evaluation, rollout, and governance of AI-assisted development practices — including code generation, automated code review, test generation, and documentation — ensuring responsible and effective use at scale.
Partners with product and platform teams to identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate delivery quality, developer experience, or operational efficiency.
Stays current on the evolving AI development tooling landscape and shapes Optimizely's internal point of view on what to adopt, build, or avoid.

Leads cross-team retrospectives, post-mortems, and process reviews that result in durable operational improvements — not just one-off fixes.
Drives internal engineering improvement initiatives: developer experience programs, productivity tooling, onboarding quality, and knowledge-sharing systems.
Partners with the CTO to continuously improve the engineering team's overall structure, organization, and delivery of results.

Fosters an environment that treats sound architecture, high-quality implementations, and secure systems as first-class product requirements.
Understands the business and operational context of our products and develops strategy to improve how we build and deliver software.
Collaborates in organizational and technical decision-making, with contributions that weigh growth, cost, margin, time-to-market, quality, and future readiness.
Coaches, mentors, and supports experienced engineering leaders, helping them become self-sufficient and solve their own challenges.
Leads engineering retention, recruiting, employer branding, and organizational strategy in a growth environment.
Participates as an amplifier of holistic organizational initiatives and company-wide direction.
Drives value initiatives that extend beyond Engineering to benefit the broader business.

Knowledge And Experience

Demonstrated history of implementing and managing significant software development programs.
Hands-on experience adopting and scaling AI coding and developer productivity tools within an engineering organization.
Familiarity with the AI development tooling landscape — including LLM-powered assistants, automated testing/review tools, and prompt engineering practices for software workflows.
5+ years of prior career experience as a software engineer.
12+ years of experience in engineering management.
Proven track record running or significantly improving engineering operations: metrics programs, operating cadences, process design, and internal tooling.
Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, organizational design, and driving execution at scale.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science or engineering preferred) or equivalent work experience

The Director, AI & Automation leads the team responsible for building and scaling the organization's automation and agentic AI capabilities. This role owns a team of engineers working across two closely related domains: workflow orchestration and deterministic automation, and agentic coding practices and AI-enabled engineering.

This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role at the leading edge of how the organization applies AI to internal operations. The Director is expected to be a practitioner and a leader - someone who understands the technology deeply enough to make good engineering decisions, develop strong engineers, and contribute meaningfully to how the organization thinks about AI adoption and governance over time.

Essential Functions

Lead a team of engineers across agentic AI and workflow automation disciplines, organized into self-directed pods aligned to business domains; ensure pods are staffed, enabled, and delivering effectively.
Own engineering quality and technical standards across both workflow orchestration and deterministic automation, as well as agentic AI tooling and practices.
Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the team - establishing patterns, evaluating emerging approaches, and building engineering fluency in AI-assisted development at scale.
Partner with Product Owners embedded in each pod to ensure engineers have clear priorities, well-defined work, and the technical context needed to deliver effectively.
Ensure continuous rapid evaluation of automation tooling, frameworks, and agentic patterns, bringing well-reasoned recommendations to leadership and contributing to governance conversations as a technical voice.
Participate in AI governance and definition of responsible AI frameworks, helping to establish standards for how the organization deploys, monitors, and evaluates AI-driven automation in production.
Manage the full engineer lifecycle across the team - hiring, onboarding, performance, growth, and retention - with particular attention to developing engineers in a fast-moving and ambiguous technology domain.
Maintain visibility into pod delivery across all business domains; surface risks, capacity issues, and cross-pod dependencies to leadership before they become blockers.
Represent the AI & Intelligent Automation engineering function in cross-functional conversations with technology leadership, business stakeholders, and vendor partners.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Equivalent experience accepted.
6+ years of experience in technology, engineering, or IT operations, with at least 2 years managing large teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead engineers or technical teams working in fast-moving, ambiguous domains where standards and practices are still being established.

Responsibilities

MaxLinear is seeking a Director of Product Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

Build and mentor engineering talent while fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation
Drive seamless transition of products from design to manufacturing and own product manufacturing performance throughout the entire product lifecycle
Lead product bring-up, silicon validation, characterization, qualification, and production release activities
Define organizational strategy, goals, KPIs, and resource plans aligned with company objectives
Collaborate closely with cross functional organizations to optimize performance, yield, testability, and manufacturability
Establish manufacturing readiness criteria and ensure successful product ramp
Own product yield improvement initiatives across wafer fabrication, assembly, and final test operations
Implement statistical process control (SPC), DOE, FMEA, and advanced analytics techniques.
Analyze product and test data to identify yield detractors and implement corrective actions
Develop strategies to improve cost of test, manufacturing efficiency, and overall product margins
Support customer escalations, product quality investigations, and field-return analysis
Establish and manage OSAT scorecards and KPIs to ensure world-class execution in quality, yield, cost, delivery, and cycle time

Qualifications

Experience with releasing products on advanced CMOS Process nodes (16nm and below)
Deep knowledge of mm-wave, RF, Mixed signal and CMOS logic circuit principles
Knowledge and experience with ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), such as Verigy and Teradyne
Experience with Data Analysis S/W such as Galaxy, Data Conductor or DataPower to create Characterization Reports and monitor production Yield
Experience recruiting, managing, and mentoring an engineering team
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 13 years of experience, or MS + 11 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 8 years of experience

Compensation And Benefits

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $ 187,000 to $251 , Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Previous management experience building and managing large engineering teams is a must
Broad knowledge of analog circuit and system hardware integration, firmware and software in application layer issues; experience in RF/SI simulation tool (ADS or HFSS)
Extensive knowledge of optical transceiver products at system and application levels including optical modules and components, and optical communications systems

Strong ownership to productively drive customer technical issues to closure, interfacing between the customer and internal engineering
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with customers and various internal groups such as marketing, engineering, sales, and operations
Previous experience of supporting IC products in a high-volume market

Able to deal with both technical and business challenges
