Main Responsibilities

The Head of Platform Technologies will lead a Subject Matter Experts (SME) team to deliver the following core objectives:

Lead the evaluation of Sanofis nextgeneration platform technologies including perfusion cell culture, continuous purification, advanced Process Analytical Technology (PAT), smart manufacturing, and emerging novel process chemistries. Develop the MSAT position on development data package requirements, atscale operational readiness, transferability, labscale model expectations, and MSAT training and expertise needs. Ensure alignment of platformtechnology initiatives with broader organizational objectives such as 2ndgeneration program development, process robustness, and yield improvement.

Establish and maintain cuttingedge innovation laboratory infrastructures within the COE. Partner with upstream, downstream, and analytical teams to advance lab digitization and automation. Build additional laboratory and pilotscale capabilities that embody Sanofis smartlab future concept.

Build and maintain strategic relationships with external partners and vendors. Oversee multiple collaboration projects with external suppliers to support manufacturing investigations, process development, raw material characterization, novel equipment and capability assessment, and codevelopment of new technologies. Coordinate these activities seamlessly with MSAT, R&D, and Global Procurement functions.

Drive global MSAT innovation initiatives in collaboration with other technology platforms (Vaccines, Drug Product, Microbial). Promote knowledge sharing and bestpractice adoption across teams. Represent MSATs scientific excellence in internal forums (smart factory, digital transformation, eco-design, efficiency) and external forums (Bio-Industry forums, biomanufacturing conferences). Strengthening Sanofis reputation as a leader in biopharmaceutical manufacturing innovation.

Contribute to CoE activities by providing SME input and technical guidance for laboratory work, commercial program life cycle management, and technology transfers. Collaborate effectively with both local and network cross-function teams (e.g. lab, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, business etc.) as needed.

Mentor and develop team members, fostering their professional growth and technical expertise, while ensuring a diverse technical background and comprehensive skillset coverage for drug substance processes as part of CoE strategic workforce planning.

About You

Basic Qualifications

PhD degree in Chemical/Biological/ Sciences/Engineering - preferred. Master's degree - required.

10+ years of experience related to biopharmaceutical industry - required.

5+ years of hands-on experience in biologics drug substance process development, technology development or manufacturing support - required.

Demonstrated experience leading bioprocess and biomanufacturing innovation initiatives from concept through implementation. Deep knowledge of bioprocess development and operations (e.g., upstream, downstream, drugsubstance stability). Familiarity with laboratory, pilotscale, and largescale manufacturing operations.

Process knowledge across multiple modalities (e.g. mAbs, small protein and peptide, bioconjugates, nucleotides, Gene/cell therapy, organic chemistry etc.)

Prior experience of managing suppliers, contractor manufacturing or contract research partners

Excellent scientific background and effective communication skills. Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines. Highly motivated individual, with the ability to work independently as well as within cross-functional and cross-site teams

Oral and written fluency in English

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention andwellness programs and at least 14 weeks gender-neutral parental leave.

Are you an engineering leader who knows how to build strong teams and get the most out of them? Do you have a track record of turning talent, tools, and process improvements into real gains in delivery speed and quality? Are you ready to lead engineering talent strategy for a large, global technology platform that supports clients around the world? If so, come join the world's leading professional services firm!

Work you'll do

The Senior Manager of Engineering for the Global Employer Services Technology Center leads engineering talent, productivity, and capability across multiple product teams supporting our GlobalAdvantage (GA) platform. The role is a member of our product leadership team and works horizontally across teams to elevate and accelerate engineering outcomes. This leadership role has visibility across all technical domains and provides a direct hand in deciding where engineering talent will deliver the most value.

The Engineering Manager owns the people side of delivery: productivity, capability, development, and deployment. This role is built on close partnership with product leads, architects, principal engineers, TPOs, and engineering leads. The outcomes driven by this role include identifying where the organization should invest in tooling, talent, skills development, and improved operating practices.

Assessing engineering productivity, capability, workload, and skill coverage across product groups through 1:1 conversations and software development lifecycle metrics
Partnering with Product Owners and technical leaders to spot delivery trends and patterns, and proposing the development, allocation, process, or tooling improvements
Building and running hiring, coaching, upskilling, and talent-allocation plans
Tracking how these investments are improving delivery speed while maintaining quality, maintainability, and engineering standards
Facilitating decisions across product teams as a partner to each team, with accountability for talent outcomes across the full portfolio

Experience leading engineering teams across multiple product groups
Direct, hands-on experience hiring, developing, managing the performance of, and allocating engineering talent
Implementing and leveraging engineering productivity metrics to guide real decisions, not just report on activity
Experience leading distributed and global engineering teams
Strong influence skills for a matrixed organization, where product, architecture, delivery, and people responsibilities are distributed

Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills

Experience with and direct responsibility for hiring, talent development, performance management, and allocation

Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability in a matrixed organization

This role establishes the vision, goals, and operating framework for how emerging technologies are identified, developed, and progressed through the product lifecycle, ensuring alignment with product group strategies, program objectives, and organizational priorities.

The Sr. Manager leads and develops a team of product management professionals, oversees resource allocation and budget execution, and plays a central role in fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners to enable effective, coordinated advancement of product pathways.

Success in this role requires strong leadership and organizational judgment, the ability to set direction and align resources across complex priorities, and the ability to translate strategic goals into sustained performance through teams operating in dynamic and evolving market environments

This position is based in the Portland, OR metro area, with a hybrid work location. We are looking for candidates who can meet the requirement of working at least 3 days per week onsite at NEEA’s office location.
Finalists must have eligibility to work in the US as NEEA is not able to provide VISA sponsorship or have remote work outside of the US.

Salary range: $155,000 - $170,000, exempt

The Typical Day May Include…

Define and lead the strategy, priorities, and performance of the Emerging Technology and Product Management function to support NEEA’s long‑term market transformation objectives.
Establish and maintain the operating framework, processes, and standards for product management from technology identification through market adoption, ensuring consistent, high‑quality execution across product areas.
Set direction for how resources, capabilities, and initiatives are aligned to support product strategy development, validation, and portfolio outcomes.
Lead and develop a team of product management professionals, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and capability development to ensure sustained organizational effectiveness.
Oversee and direct the planning, execution, and performance of the Emerging Technology portfolio, including budget management, resource allocation, and delivery of business outcomes.
Guide cross‑functional alignment among product management, program management, and market strategy teams to ensure integrated planning, coordinated execution, and effective use of organizational resources.
Represent NEEA’s Emerging Technology and Product Management interests in regional and national forums to influence collaboration, partnerships, and approaches to advancing the energy efficiency pipeline.
Establish and maintain strategic relationships with external stakeholders, including funders, industry organizations, and partners, to support alignment, information exchange, and long‑term impact.
Monitor and assess emerging market, technology, and organizational trends and adjust functional strategy to address evolving opportunities and risks.
Ensure clear communication of strategy, priorities, performance, and outcomes to senior leadership, stakeholders, and funders
Perform other duties which may be necessary or desirable to support the organization’s success.

new_jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

As the Director, Lifecycle Technology & Operations, you will lead the global operating model and technical foundation that enables Lifecycle Marketing to deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences at scale.

You will oversee global Lifecycle Operations while serving as the primary Lifecycle business owner for our customer engagement and orchestration platform and the broader technology and data ecosystem that powers customer engagement. Today, Braze sits at the center of that ecosystem. You will define platform strategy and stewardship; journey and campaign operations; customer data and audience capabilities; personalization and decisioning; governance; automation; capacity; and partner delivery. JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Leads and directs team responsible for enterprise infrastructure and information technology (IT) operations. Responsible for delivering reliable, high‑performing technology services across infrastructure, data, and operational support functions. Ensures service quality and performance by monitoring operational health, analyzing trends, and maintaining alignment with established service level agreements (SLAs) and organizational expectations. Partners with business leaders and stakeholders to define, evaluate, and communicate IT performance across systems, applications, services, and project portfolios. Drives process, service, and operational improvements to enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer experience. Builds strong business relationships to set expectations, proactively identify risks, and resolve issues with appropriate priority and visibility. Provides strategic oversight, guidance, and leadership to ensure IT services meet evolving business needs and support enterprise goals.

Essential Job Duties

Oversees team responsible for translating business needs into IT work product and project requests; assimilates and documents business needs, project requests and benefit value documentation including high level IT requirements, compliance implications and cost/benefit analysis.
Partners with IT leadership and IT project managers on key initiatives to identify dependencies/issue escalation from business participants and project management; ensures transition of projects into applicable tracking systems.
Provides technical and process knowledge within IT across silos and business partners to support consulting, problem resolution/facilitation and effective intake and solutioning; coaches and recommended solutions for project deliverables including business requirements document (BRD).
Analyzes, reviews and measures information technology (IT)-related service level performance against agreed upon service level agreements (SLAs) and operating level agreements (OLAs) with service providers (internal and external).
Identifies opportunities to increase efficiency through continuous improvement and process optimization with consideration to budget impacts.
Participates in IT service development and reporting of service level agreements (SLAs) to business stakeholders; champions IT service management (ITSM) processes, provides training and support for process rollouts, monitors processes, business feedback, and effective rollout of revised processes.
Organizes complex IT project requests into manageable approaches, and advises on project setup/structure based on proposed scope.
Collaborates with corporate IT leadership on key business initiative delivery; facilitates process improvements, manages SLAs, and deploys business communications.
Leverages knowledge of business processes, IT technologies and processes to inform appropriate project triage; consults with the business/IT on project scope, assumptions, development progress and estimation.
Strategically informs standard business case development method outlined by IT project team to support evaluation and prioritization.
Drives down the cost of development and support while improving quality by implementing standard processes (systems development lifecycle (SDLC), architecture, project management, etc.).
Recognizes, identifies and documents changes to IT services and supporting processes and or opportunities for service delivery improvement; facilitates groups for problem-solving and service improvement including definition/documentation, and business workflow analysis.
Develops effective processes, forums and tracking mechanisms to continuously improve process through business feedback, proactive handling of business complaints and facilitation of resolution.
Develops and maintains a service delivery plan (SDP) for corporate functions to include business strategies/needs with corresponding IT strategies/plans, IT projects, IT performance measurements, customer satisfaction improvement plans and other items as determined by IT senior leadership.
Builds, manages and maintains effective business relationships with key stakeholders across business domains and multiple corporate functions to support IT service delivery.
Collaborates closely with business partners and service providers to negotiate and define service‑level requirements for new IT services and changes to existing services.
Collaborates with business and service providers to define proper metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) in evaluating service delivery quality and performance levels.
Generates and distributes regular reports on service performance, trends and achievement to applicable stakeholders.
Organizes and maintains the service level review process with the business and service providers; initiates actions required to maintain or improve service levels.
Represents as a change agent to implement and manage quality improvement processes in service delivery management.
Monitors budgets and expenses within department and demonstrates accountability for meeting financial goals.
Provides recommendations and input into IT-related policies, procedures and governance standards.
Provides IT support and coordination to functions/departments to facilitate timely issue resolution and service restoration
Effectively manages business escalations within the IT organization by ensuring appropriate accountability, sense of urgency, communication and follow-through to closure.
Develops and implements reports using repeatable processes to satisfy key business stakeholders; supports continuous improvements of established reports in production to ensure optimal performance.
Maintains technical skills that can be utilized to solve complex IT problems.
Hires, trains, mentors, and develops a high-performing team, and demonstrates accountability for team performance and achievement of department-specific goals.

Required Qualifications

At least 8 years of information technology (IT) and systems experience, including advanced experience with IT service level performance, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
At least 3 years of management/leadership experience.
Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, statistics, business, health care, engineering, etc.
Advanced understanding of IT operations and major health care technology applications that support business functions.
Experience providing IT support in alignment with state Medicaid contract service level agreement (SLA) requirements.
Knowledge of emerging technologies required to support business needs and project execution.
Subject matter expertise/knowledge of managed care organization (MCO) contract compliance requirements that impact IT services or processes.
Knowledge of health care payer processes/industry/trends.
Understanding of business management, operations, and strategy.
Understanding of key functions, application accountabilities and services performed by each area including knowledge of PMO, architecture and service methodologies (current or developing), and ability to train the business on applicable services, processes and technologies.
Experience in strategic planning, project scoping and planning and background/experience in project management and use of project management tools.
Strong data-analysis and critical-thinking skills.
Experience summarizing data and creation and delivery of leadership presentations.
Analytical ability to identify issues, solve problems and develop/facilitate solutions; includes alternative analysis and cost/benefit analysis/project value realization.
Experience facilitating change management and process improvement initiatives.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, and excellent follow-through.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a highly matrixed organization, and influence stakeholders on scalable solutions.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Proficiency with the Microsoft technology stack (including advanced Excel) and working knowledge of SQL.

Preferred Qualifications

Six Sigma black belt.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification.
Understanding of health care industry regulations and compliance requirements, including those impacting Medicaid, MCO operations, and IT service delivery.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Operations - Technology Strategy & Roadmap
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Operations - Technology Strategy & Roadmap based in United States.

This is a strategic technology leadership role focused on shaping the multi-year technology roadmap for a high-volume commercial support organization.

You will translate business priorities and operating-model needs into technology capabilities spanning data systems, reporting, automation, workflow tools, and commercial platforms.

The role combines strategic planning, roadmap development, stakeholder alignment, investment prioritization, and technology-enabled business transformation.

You will work closely with Technology, Data, Product, Commercial, and enterprise teams to evaluate opportunities, dependencies, risks, and business value.

Your recommendations will help leadership make informed decisions about technology investments, modernization, sequencing, and scalable adoption.

The position offers significant cross-functional visibility and requires strong influence, structured thinking, and the ability to turn complex information into clear executive decisions.

You will also establish value-realization frameworks and transition strategies that help move technology initiatives from strategic planning through implementation and operational adoption.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering data systems, reporting platforms, automation, workflow tools, and commercial support capabilities.
Translate business strategy, operating-model requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clearly sequenced technology capabilities, roadmap themes, and delivery recommendations.
Lead annual and quarterly technology planning processes, evaluating demand, capacity, dependencies, risks, expected benefits, and overall business value.
Assess current-state tools, reporting environments, workflows, and data systems to identify modernization opportunities, simplification requirements, and future capability gaps.
Partner with Technology, Data, Product, platform, and business leaders to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards, architecture patterns, platform direction, and operational requirements.
Prepare executive-ready roadmap materials, decision frameworks, investment recommendations, prioritization options, and supporting analysis for senior leadership.
Serve as a strategic bridge between business leaders, technology partners, data teams, product teams, reporting teams, platform owners, and external vendors.
Facilitate roadmap planning and prioritization forums, aligning stakeholders around business value, technical dependencies, resources, timelines, risks, and trade-offs.
Develop clear decision materials that communicate available options, anticipated impacts, dependencies, and recommended next steps across diverse stakeholder groups.
Influence internal and external partners to advance roadmap priorities, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment between technology planning and commercial strategy.
Lead current-state and future-state assessments across reporting, automation, workflow, data, and commercial support platforms.
Develop KPI and value-realization frameworks to track roadmap progress, adoption, operational impact, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Create transition planning materials that support the movement of roadmap initiatives from strategy into delivery, implementation, adoption, and ongoing operational support.
Coordinate cross-functional technology initiatives while maintaining strong prioritization, governance, communication, and accountability.

Requirements

At least 7 years of professional work experience.
At least 4 years of experience supporting technology strategy, roadmap planning, data systems, reporting platforms, automation, analytics tools, or technology-enabled business operations.
At least 3 years of experience leading teams and cross-functional technology initiatives within an enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience translating business strategy and stakeholder requirements into technology capabilities, roadmap priorities, sequencing recommendations, and executive-level decision materials.
Strong understanding of technology planning, prioritization, business value assessment, dependencies, risks, and investment trade-offs.
Strong partner-management skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong prioritization, team management, communication, and stakeholder-influence capabilities.
Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear recommendations to senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree, or an Associate’s degree plus 6+ years of technology-related experience, or a high school diploma/GED plus 12+ years of technology-related experience.
Five or more years of professional experience in Technology or a related field is preferred.
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Comfortable operating in a highly cross-functional environment where priorities, dependencies, and technology needs may evolve.

Benefits

Annual salary: $90,000–$120,000, based on applicable and specialized experience and location.
Annual incentive: Eligibility to participate in an annual incentive/bonus plan, subject to applicable plan terms and conditions.
Remote flexibility: Fully remote position in the United States, with the role also based at the corporate office in Dallas, Texas.
Travel benefits: Access to deeply discounted hotel stays, including up to 110 discounted nights and rates as low as $40 per night through the travel program.
Employee stock purchase program: Opportunity to purchase company shares at a 15% discount, subject to program terms.
Paid parental leave: Paid leave available to eligible employees, including partners and adoptive parents.
Caregiving support: Dedicated caregiving concierge services to help employees navigate caregiving needs.
Crisis support: Access to crisis concierge services providing practical and emotional support during difficult life events.
Mental health resources: Access to counseling and support through an Employee Assistance Program.
Paid time off: Generous PTO to support rest, personal needs, and work-life balance.
Health and welfare coverage: A range of health plans supporting medical, dental, vision, and broader wellbeing needs.
Retirement benefits: Retirement plans designed to support long-term financial security.
Strategic career scope: High-visibility opportunity to influence technology strategy, roadmap decisions, modernization, and commercial operations at enterprise scale.

new_jobs.description:

As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end-to-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. You will partner directly with the Digital Marketing organization, EDT business partners, Marketing Operations, and external system integrators to drive scalable content authoring, content globalization, comprehensive campaign insights, and modern cloud architecture across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), and integrated Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities. Additionally, you will lead a team of full-time employees and managed-service partners spanning AEM technical architects, backend/frontend developers, DevOps engineers, QA, and analytics consultants, ensuring the platform delivers on brand consistency, speed-to-market, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experience objectives aligned with Stryker's Mission.

Own the end-to-end AEMaaCS platform strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), Dynamic Media, Multi-Site Manager (MSM), and the AEM Translation Integration Framework (TIF).
Lead architecture governance for the component library, page templates, blueprint/live-copy configurations, and language-copy rollouts supporting Stryker.com and 50+ country sites.
Drive modernization efforts (e.g., AMS-to-AEMaaCS migration, technical debt reduction, out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption) to enable scalable content authoring, globalization, and advanced marketing analytics.
Ensure seamless integration between AEM and adjacent platforms including Workfront, Adobe Analytics, Adobe WebSDK, Marketo, Adobe Target, and Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Oversee CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, release management, and the AEM Releases & Deployment Schedule in partnership with DevOps and system integrators.
Partner with the AEM AI initiative team to evaluate and operationalize built-in generative AI capabilities (content creation, asset tagging, experimentation) in alignment with Stryker's AI Operating Committee (AIOC) governance and residual-risk approvals.
Ensure platform compliance with Stryker IT QMS, SOX, CSV, Global Change Control, privacy/consent regulations, and cybersecurity standards.
Execute a robust talent offense by attracting, developing, retaining, and engaging top talent while driving personal/professional growth of individuals and the team, delivering high-quality results with passion, energy, and drive.
Manage a team consisting of full-time employees, contractors, and managed-service partners; define roles and responsibilities, plan for the department's future needs, counsel employees on performance, and contribute to employee pay decisions or changes.
Lead and mentor Solution Leads, Technical Leads, and Solution Analysts across build and run teams (onshore and offshore).
Serve as the EDT single point of accountability for the AEM platform to Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Corporate Communications, and Divisional marketing stakeholders.
Own program schedules, work breakdown structures, and integrated Gantt/roadmap views for the AEM portfolio.
Implement quality, risk, and procurement management strategies and templates for AEM projects and programs.
Ensure smooth build-to-run transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations.

What you need:

Required:

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of professional experience in IT and/or digital application development, including people leadership experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience delivering and operating Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x and/or AEMaaCS) solutions in a global enterprise environment.
5+ years of experience leading MSM/translation strategies, DAM architecture, component-based design, and Adobe WebSDK integrations.
2+ years of experience with track record managing global system integrators and hybrid onshore/offshore delivery models.
2+ years of experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Real-Time CDP, Commerce) preferred.
5+ years of experience with SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and IT QMS/regulatory compliance (SOX, privacy, consent).

Preferred:

Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Adobe Certified Expert / Master (AEM Sites, AEM Assets, or AEM Architect) strongly preferred.
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification preferred.
Prior experience in medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry preferred.

new_jobs.title: Sr Platform Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This role will play a critical role in developing and implementing business strategy by managing platform development initiatives from idea creation through deployment including identifying customer need, designing and validating concepts, developing business cases, managing vendor negotiations and relationships, partnering with technology to analyze and write Business and Functional Requirements documentation, managing to a budget SME in coordinating and developing communications with Marketing and Training, coordinating business and Beta testers, and implementing deliverables. Maintains a thorough knowledge of systems and operations processes for platform supported. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining subject matter expertise for platform functionality and resolving chronic service delivery or platform issues identified by client service/support organizations. Serve as primary liaison with Program Owners, Business Channel leaders, SMEs, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Legal, Compliance Risk, and external suppliers/vendors. Associates tend to work more autonomously than their lower-level platform development counterparts. Responsible for hiring, managing, training and developing other Sr platform development managers or platform development managers.

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

LOB Job Description:

This job is responsible for defining and maintaining an operational technology strategy that supports the organization's strategic process transformation objectives. Key responsibilities include translating complex operational workflows into normalized "Process Objects", aligning business needs to enterprise capabilities, maintaining process and capability taxonomies, and enabling horizontal solutions designed across business functions. The Senior Platform Manager facilitates a translation layer between operational subject matter experts, process design teams, enterprise architecture, and technology partners, ensuring business requirements are defined and articulated independently of the systems currently used to execute them.

Job expectations include working across business, operations, technology, and transformation teams to evaluate operational needs, identify reusable capability patterns, develop enterprise knowledge capture assets, and support future-state solution design. The role requires balancing operational fluency with architectural literacy while remaining neutral to specific technologies, platforms, or implementation.

Required Qualifications:

Defines and maintains Business Objects
Process integration, operations, or technology enablement
Experience collaborating well and influencing senior executives
Background in agile delivery and software testing
Ability to communicate fluently across business and technology domains
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications:

Background in Computer Science, Data Science, enterprise architecture, or related capability
MBA and/or 5+ years of relevant experience leading technology change within an operation

Skills:

Influence
Problem Solving
Process Effectiveness
Production Support
Technical Troubleshooting
Agile Practices
Attention to Detail
Planning
Prioritization
Release Management
Adaptability
Change Management
Critical Thinking
Research
Usability Testing

Minimum Education Requirement:
High School Diploma / GED / Secondary School or equivalent

40

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide.

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio.

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.

Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems.

Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security.

Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices.
Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation.
Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture.

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era

Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms.
Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences.
Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale.

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization

Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams.
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Strengthen Customer Trust

Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle.
Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.
Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust.

What You'll Bring

Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies.
Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities.
Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.
Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities

Team and organizational leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to managers and senior engineers.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Define and execute the TDP SQL strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP SQL and its partner teams.
Increase platform adoption by reducing integration complexity and delivering well-supported, production-ready capabilities.

Reliability and customer trust

Own the operational health of TDP SQL, including availability, durability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure the platform supports enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and regulated environments.
Maintain clear visibility into customer commitments and intervene when delivery or reliability risks threaten those outcomes.

Technical and platform leadership

Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the platform’s evolution across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, tenant isolation, migration safety, security, operability, and reversibility.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with dependent infrastructure and customer teams.

Cross-functional leadership and economics

Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP SQL in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, and portfolio planning.
Own the platform’s cost posture, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.

Compensation

: $188,730 - $246,398

Significant engineering leadership experience,
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, database platform, storage service, or comparable infrastructure product.

Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.

new_jobs.title: IT Director, Salesforce Platform Owner
new_jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

As IT Director, Salesforce Platform Owner, you will own the vision, roadmap, and governance of Heartflow's Salesforce ecosystem and serve as the executive liaison between IT and the business.

Salesforce at Heartflow supports more than 500 users across Commercial Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Production, and Quality Systems. Because the platform spans both commercial teams and highly regulated functions, this role calls for a leader who can move quickly on revenue-facing priorities while holding the line on compliance and data integrity.

You will act as a thought partner to business function leaders, chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee, reconcile competing departmental priorities, and turn complex business processes into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Roadmap & Governance: Chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee. Act as product owner for the platform, prioritizing investment based on business value, compliance obligations, and ROI, and communicating trade-offs transparently to stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Serve as the primary IT point of contact for department heads. Lead discovery sessions to understand their workflows in depth and translate what you learn into clear business requirements and user stories.
Cross-Functional IT Collaboration: Partner with IT development and platform teams to hand off groomed requirements for execution in an Agile/Scrum model, staying engaged through delivery.
Process Optimization & Adoption: Audit commercial and clinical workflows to find bottlenecks and manual workarounds. Champion adoption, lead User Acceptance Testing, and drive change management for new releases.
Data & Revenue Integrity: Work with business and IT teams to enforce Master Data Management practices, and ensure Salesforce (front office) and NetSuite (back office) stay integrated so data silos and reconciliation gaps don't form.
Compliance & Validation: Ensure platform changes follow Heartflow's change control, SOX, and quality system requirements, partnering with Quality and InfoSec on validation and access governance where applicable.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 8-10+ years in Enterprise Applications, Business Systems, or RevOps, including 3+ years in a Director-level or strategic Product Owner / Business Partner role.
Salesforce Depth: Strong functional and architectural understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud and Service Cloud required; CPQ, Health Cloud, or Revenue Cloud a significant plus).
Stakeholder Management: Be an exceptional communicator with a track record of resolving conflicting priorities and building consensus across departments with different incentives.
Industry Experience: Life Sciences, MedTech, Biotech, or another regulated public company environment (SOX, HIPAA, FDA, quality systems) strongly preferred.
Methodology: Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum and in translating ambiguous business needs into deliverables the IT development team can build.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $220,000 to $270,000 per year, bonus, and equity.

Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.

Overview

Banyan Group is an independent, global hospitality company with purpose. We pride itself on its pioneering spirit, design-led experiences and commitment to responsible stewardship. Its extensive portfolio spans 100 hotels and resorts, more than 140 spas and galleries, and 20 plus branded residences in over 20 countries. Comprising 12 global brands, including the flagship brand Banyan Tree, each distinct yet united under the experiential membership programme withBanyan. The founding ethos of “Embracing the Environment, Empowering People” is embodied through the Banyan Global Foundation and Banyan Academy. We are committed to remaining the leading advocate of sustainable travel, with a focus on regenerative tourism and innovative programmes that elevate the guest experience.

Founded in 1994 on the core concept of sustainability, Banyan Tree Holdings seeks to create long-term value for all stakeholders and destinations across its network of properties, products and brands, through a purpose-driven mission.

With over 13,000 associates across 23 countries, the Group established the Banyan Academy in 2008 to support its goals by advancing people development, management excellence, and fostering learning with integrity and meaning.

Banyan Group has received over 3,000 industry awards and accolades since its inception. It has also received recognition for its commitment to environmental protection and community development through its non-profit arm, the Banyan Global Foundation, which aligns the Group’s efforts with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs).

Position Summary

Banyan Tree Escape Balak
is seeking an experienced and technically strong Director - Engineering
to lead the Engineering function through the pre-opening phase and into full operations. Reporting to the General Manager, you will work closely with the owner, project team, consultants, and contractors to ensure the resort is built, commissioned, and handed over to the highest standards, while establishing a sustainable and efficient maintenance culture.
The successful candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep knowledge of luxury resort facilities, building systems, and Indonesian regulatory requirements. This role will drive engineering excellence by safeguarding asset quality, ensuring guest and associate safety, optimizing energy and resource efficiency, and building a competent, motivated team.
Candidates with proven experience in luxury resort pre-openings or engineering leadership in Bali or elsewhere in Indonesia are highly preferred.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage all Engineering functions, ensuring alignment with business goals and brand standards.
Represent the operator during the construction and pre-opening phases, reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and equipment selections from an operational perspective.
Coordinate with the project team, consultants, and contractors on snagging, testing, commissioning, and handover of all building systems and equipment.
Develop the pre-opening Engineering master plan, including organization structure, manning guides, recruitment timeline, and training schedule.
Establish preventive and predictive maintenance programs, asset registers, spare parts inventory, and operating manuals.
Oversee the operation and maintenance of MEP systems, HVAC, water treatment, swimming pools, power generation, fire and life safety systems, and other resort infrastructure.
Manage the upkeep of villas, public areas, landscaping infrastructure, and back-of-house facilities to maintain luxury standards.
Drive energy, water, and waste management programs in line with the brand's sustainability commitments.
Ensure full compliance with Indonesian building, environmental, and safety regulations, and obtain and maintain all required licenses, certifications, and permits (including SLF, fire safety, and lift and pressure vessel certifications).
Develop and maintain occupational health and safety programs, emergency procedures, and regular drills.
Prepare and control the pre-opening and annual Engineering budgets, including capital expenditure and utility costs.
Manage contractors, vendors, and service agreements to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.
Recruit, train, and develop the Engineering team, building strong local talent and succession plans.
Partner with Operations, Rooms, Food & Beverage, and Spa to respond promptly to guest and operational needs.
Provide regular Engineering updates and reports to Regional Engineering / Corporate and senior management.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or related fields.
Minimum 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role within luxury hotels or resorts.
Proven pre-opening experience, including involvement in construction, commissioning, and handover, is strongly preferred.
Strong experience in the Bali or Indonesian hospitality market is highly preferred.
Excellent knowledge of MEP systems, building management systems, and resort infrastructure, including water, power, and wastewater systems.
Sound understanding of Indonesian building codes, environmental regulations, and occupational health and safety requirements.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate with owners, consultants, and contractors.

The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, advanced analytics capabilities, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

As a Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering, you lead a team of AI/ML Engineers, setting technical direction, building delivery capability, and ensuring your team produces production-grade AI/ML systems that drive measurable business value. Your team sits at the intersection of software engineering and AI/ML — engineers who go beyond platform and MLOps work to apply existing AI models and algorithms to specific business problems, setting up training pipelines, transforming data for AI use, fine-tuning models for performance, and orchestrating multiple algorithm steps to build end-to-end AI solutions.

You establish AI/ML engineering best practices spanning model development, training infrastructure, MLOps, and GenAI systems, manage performance, coach team members on engineering craft and responsible AI, and create an environment that fosters innovation and engineering excellence. You maintain strong technical credibility, partner closely with applied science, data engineering, product, and business stakeholders, and ensure AI/ML engineering work is delivered reliably at the highest quality.

Own delivery across the team's AI/ML engineering work from problem framing through to production stability — sequencing workstreams that span both AI solution building (training, fine-tuning, algorithm orchestration) and deployment infrastructure (MLOps, serving, monitoring), managing dependencies, and making execution trade-offs that keep programs on track
Set technical direction for the AI/ML engineering capability area — translating business and applied science requirements into engineering programs that apply existing AI models and algorithms to specific use cases, and making platform, MLOps, and architectural choices that enable reliable delivery at scale
Contribute hands-on to critical engineering work including AI solution design, model deployment, training infrastructure, model serving, and system design problems — demonstrating best practices, unblocking the team on hard problems, and maintaining technical credibility
Establish AI/ML engineering standards — including how to set up and manage training pipelines, transform and prepare data for AI model use, fine-tune existing models for performance on specific use cases, and orchestrate multiple algorithm steps into cohesive AI solutions
Build and maintain the operational foundation for how AI solutions are deployed and run in production — including CI/CD for ML, model drift alerting, rollback protocols, and serving reliability

10-12 years of applicable experience

Prioritize AI/ML investments within the team's scope, weighing platform and tooling spend, compute infrastructure, and foundation model adoption against expected business value
Build and maintain the team's AI/ML delivery systems — covering both the AI solution pipeline (training, fine-tuning, data preparation, algorithm orchestration) and production operations (CI/CD for ML, deployment patterns, monitoring, rollback, lifecycle management)

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core Engineering, Trusted Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data-storage capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP SQL is Atlassian’s managed relational database platform. It gives engineering teams a supported way to build applications on relational databases without having to manage the underlying infrastructure, availability, security, scaling, and enterprise controls independently.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP SQL engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to evolve TDP SQL as a dependable, easy-to-adopt internal platform.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, operating a highly reliable platform, and translating complex customer and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities

Team and organizational leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to managers and senior engineers.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.

Strategy and execution

Define and execute the TDP SQL strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, and platform requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP SQL and its partner teams.
Increase platform adoption by reducing integration complexity and delivering well-supported, production-ready capabilities.

Reliability and customer trust

Own the operational health of TDP SQL, including availability, durability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure the platform supports enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and regulated environments.
Maintain clear visibility into customer commitments and intervene when delivery or reliability risks threaten those outcomes.

Technical and platform leadership

Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the platform’s evolution across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, tenant isolation, migration safety, security, operability, and reversibility.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with dependent infrastructure and customer teams.

Cross-functional leadership and economics

Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP SQL in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, and portfolio planning.
Own the platform’s cost posture, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States
, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A
: $209,700 - $273,775

Zone B
: $188,730 - $246,398

Zone C
: $174,051 - $227,233

Qualifications

Significant engineering leadership experience,
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, database platform, storage service, or comparable infrastructure product.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, organizational design, hiring, and succession planning.
Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, security, and operational risk.
Experience delivering enterprise capabilities such as data residency, encryption, compliance, disaster recovery, or tenant isolation.
Proven ability to lead incident response and convert operational learning into lasting improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and experience resolving dependencies between organizations with different priorities.
Sound judgment when balancing reliability, strategic alignment, delivery speed, cost, and technical sustainability.
Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.

Experience with managed SQL platforms (TiDB is a plus), distributed relational databases, multi-cloud infrastructure, large-scale migrations, or internal developer platforms is beneficial but not required.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits
.

The Residential Assistant Director of Engineering forms part of the Residential team who collectively make key strategic and operational decisions for Building, overseeing all engineering operations for interior/exterior facilities including plumbing, refrigeration, heating/cooling, painting, carpentry, structural, recycling, electrical, ground care and parking areas. new_jobs.title: Global Security Core Technology Director
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced leader to join our Global Security – Systems and Technology (GSST) team. GSST manages and advances the state of physical security technology and building systems through strategy, design, and innovation. The Core Technology leader will drive impact across Meta's global offices, retail, data centers, and non-traditional site portfolio through technical design, scalable processes, tool development, and business acumen that together enable an efficient and durable technology stack.The ideal candidate brings deep command of technology design and uses it to guide and influence scalable solutions — both technology and non-technology — across Meta's physical environment. This role partners with cross-functional teams company-wide to ensure Global Security standards and objectives are embedded into the processes that create predictability for Global Security design and operations.

Global Security Core Technology Director Responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end strategy, design, and operation of Core Systems, including access control, security cameras, card readers, and video analytics platforms.
Lead the architecture of server and cloud environments purpose-built for physical security workloads.
Drive integrations and automations that connect physical security systems into a cohesive, intelligent technology stack.
Develop and maintain 3–5 year technology roadmaps aligned to the Global Security long-term vision, with clear linkage to OKRs and key objectives.
Lead manufacturing vendors on hardware direction, lifecycle management, and roadmap alignment.
Build stakeholder consensus on the adoption of new products and designs by creating an inclusive forum for collaboration.
Set expectations for the team's managed software lifecycles — provisioning, deployment, maintenance, firmware upgrades, and end-of-life programs — and measure execution against them.
Lead and develop teams that execute platform upgrades of highly sensitive, employee-facing systems (e.g., Genetec version upgrades, Linux/Kubernetes migrations) with minimal operational disruption.
Own system health metrics, SLA performance, and operational dashboards.
Manage on-call escalation frameworks and SEV response for security systems.
Assess security and business risk in early planning phases to influence risk avoidance and long-term outcomes.
Provide administration and oversight of all vendor contracts for Core Systems, engaging key stakeholders to drive alignment.
Deliver a well-defined, coordinated set of design documents that capture project design intent and all relevant standards and guidelines.
Educate technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels of the organization on design requirements and the reasoning behind them.
Integrate physical security and core system elements into a single operational delivery plan for Global Security.
Manage the team to deliver physical security technology projects end to end — on time, within budget, and to required quality standards.
Lead stakeholder communication and collaboration to ensure timely information transfer across connected teams and partners.
Own org design: headcount planning, resource advocacy, bench talent development, and workforce optimization strategy.
Lead a global team of technical program managers, systems engineers, and contingent workers across NORAM, EMEA, and APAC.
Establish operating cadences — weekly syncs, bi-weekly team meetings, monthly leadership updates, and quarterly business reviews — that keep the team connected to and positively impacting partners.
Drive performance and build culture through clear goal-setting, check-in reviews, and ongoing structured feedback focused on growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

12+ years of progressive experience in physical security systems, security technology, or related infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years leading technical teams
Demonstrated experience designing and managing server and/or cloud-hosted environments for security or IoT workloads
Proven ability to build and lead teams of senior subject matter experts across integrations, automations, and data architecture
Experience with manufacturing vendor partnerships and hardware lifecycle management
Demonstrated budget ownership, annual forecasting, and financial accountability
Experience developing and communicating long-term technology strategy to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners
Experience preparing annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and monthly reporting across multiple projects or programs
Knowledge of physical security principles, including commonly used concepts, strategies, practices, and procedures
Experience communicating technical detail to all organizational levels, including non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with modern data engineering practices: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and governance frameworks
Experience in hyperscale technology companies or similarly complex operating environments
Knowledge of industry standards and compliance frameworks relevant to physical security (e.g., ONVIF, OSDP, UL 294)
Physical security certification (PSP, CPP, CPTED, or similar)

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

$230,000/year to $285,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits
